<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find the smallest number of coins I can be given in change when paying a bill for $\pounds 2.34$ with a $\pounds 5$ note.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the smallest number of coins I can be given in change when paying a bill for $\pounds 2.34$ with a $\pounds 5$ note.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- The coins available are: $1 \ \text{p}$, $2 \ \text{p}$, $5 \ \text{p}$, $10 \ \text{p}$, $20 \ \text{p}$, $50 \ \text{p}$, $\pounds 1$, $\pounds 2$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Change received}     &= 5 - 2.34 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 2.66 \\\\
\text {Coins received}      &= \pounds 2, 50 \ \text{p}, 10 \ \text{p}, 5 \ \text{p},1 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Number of coins}     &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sophie and her friends decided to raise money for charity by baking and selling cookies.
They set themselves a target of $\pounds 200$ profit to raise.

Each cookie cost them $10 \ \text{p}$ to make and they sold them for $50 \ \text{p}$.

How many cookies did they need to sell to reach their target?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sophie and her friends decided to raise money for charity by baking and selling cookies.
They set themselves a target of $\pounds 200$ profit to raise.
<emptyline>
Each cookie cost them $10 \ \text{p}$ to make and they sold them for $50 \ \text{p}$.
<emptyline>
How many cookies did they need to sell to reach their target?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The cookie cost is given in pence and the target is given in pounds. Let's convert the target into pence.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total target}                     &= \pounds 200 \\\\
                                         &= 200 \times 100 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                         &= 20000 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Cost of each cookie}              &= 10 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Sale Price for each cookie}       &= 50 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Profit per cookie}                &= 50 - 10 \\\\
                                         &= 40 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of cookies needed}             &= \dfrac {\text {Total target}} {\text {Profit per cookie}} \\\\
                                             &= \dfrac {20000} {40} \\\\
                                             &= \dfrac {40 \times 500} {40} \\\\
                                             &= \dfrac {\cancel {40} \times 500} {\cancel {40}} \\\\
                                             &= 500
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of cookies $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(50 - 10) \times c              &= 20000 \\\\
40c                             &= 20000 \\\\
c                               &= \dfrac {20000} {40} \\\\
c                               &= \dfrac {40 \times 500} {40} \\\\
c                               &= \dfrac {\cancel {40} \times 500} {\cancel {40}} \\\\
c                               &= 500
\end{aligned}
$

Number of cookies needed $= 500$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$500$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Katie's mum gives her $\pounds 10$.

She spends $\pounds 1.90$ on magazines, $\pounds 2.45$ on a birthday card and $75 \ \text{p}$ on chocolate. How much money does she have left? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Katie's mum gives her $\pounds 10$.
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= \pounds 1.90 +  \pounds 2.45 + 75 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.90 +  \pounds 2.45 + \pounds 0.75 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 5.10 \\\\
\text {Money left}      &= 10 - 5.10 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.90
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 4.90$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jake buys $2$ coffees, a milkshake and a cappuccino.

How much change does he receive from a $ \pounds 10?$

|      Drinks Menu     |                   |
|:--------------------:|:-----------------:|
|          Tea         |  $\pounds 1.40$   |
|         Coffee       |  $\pounds 1.60$   |       
|        Cappuccino    |  $\pounds 1.90$   |  
|     Hot Chocolate    |  $\pounds 1.50$   |
|     Fruit Juice      |  $\pounds 1.20$   |       
|        Milkshake     |  $\pounds 1.70$   |     
|        Smoothie      |  $\pounds 1.30$   |       
|        Fizzy Pop     |  $\pounds 1.00$   |      


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Decrease $\pounds 44$ by $10\%$.

- $\pounds 39.60$
- $\pounds 4.40$
- $\pounds 48.40$
- $\pounds 34$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Decrease $\pounds 44$ by $10\%$.
<emptyline>
- $\pounds 39.60$
- $\pounds 4.40$
- $\pounds 48.40$
- $\pounds 34$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the amount is reduced by $10 \%$, then the reduced value will be $100 - 10 = 90 \%$ of the original value. Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 90 \% \ \text {of} \ \text 44 \\\\
&= \dfrac {90} {100} \times 44 \\\\
&= \dfrac {90 \times 44} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3960} {100} \\\\
&= \pounds 39.60 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 44 - 10 \% \ \text {of} \ 44 \\\\
&= 44 - \dfrac {10} {100} \times 44 \\\\
&= 44 - \dfrac {10 \times 44} {100} \\\\
&= 44 - \dfrac {440} {100} \\\\
&= 44 - 4.40 \\\\
&= \pounds 39.60 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 39.60$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of $\pounds 40$. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of $\pounds 40$. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {2}{5} \text{ of } \pounds 40 \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 40}{5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 5 \times 8}{5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times \cancel{5} \times 8}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
&= 2 \times 8 \\\\
&= \pounds 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 16$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ruby has collected thirty-five $5 \ \text{p}$ coins for charity.

How much more does she need to reach $\pounds 5?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ruby has collected thirty-five $5 \ \text{p}$ coins for charity.
<emptyline>
How much more does she need to reach $\pounds 5?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Amount collected}    &= 35 \times 5 \\\\
                            &= 175 \ \text{p}  \\\\
                            &= \pounds 1.75 \\\\
\text {Amount needed}       &= 5 - 1.75 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 3.25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I buy $2$ cakes for $45 \ \text{p}$ each and a drink for $90 \ \text{p}$. 
What change will I have from a $\pounds 5$ note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I buy $2$ cakes for $45 \ \text{p}$ each and a drink for $90 \ \text{p}$. 
What change will I have from a $\pounds 5$ note?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 2 \times 45 + 90 \\\\
                        &= 90 + 90 \\\\
                        &= 180 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.80 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 5 - 1.80 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 3.20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 3.20$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I buy $6$ packets of crisps from the $\pounds 1.99$ store where everything costs $\pounds 1.99$. How much change do I get 
from $\pounds 20?$

-  $6 \ \text{p}$ 
-  $\pounds 6.99$ 
-  $\pounds 11.94$ 
-  $\pounds 4.06$ 
-  $\pounds 8.06$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I set off with a $\pounds 10$ note to buy a book costing $\pounds 4.95$, a cake 
costing  $\pounds 1.30$ and a new pen. I got  $\pounds 2.25$ change. 

How much did the pen cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I set off with a $\pounds 10$ note to buy a book costing $\pounds 4.95$, a cake 
costing  $\pounds 1.30$ and a new pen. I got  $\pounds 2.25$ change. 
<emptyline>
How much did the pen cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of pen}     &= 10 - 4.95 - 1.30 - 2.25 \\\\
                        &= 5.05 - 1.30 - 2.25 \\\\
                        &= 3.75 - 2.25 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Autnie Jean is saving all her $5 \ \text{p}$ coins in a jar.

The total amount of money in the jar is  $\pounds 18.55$.

How many coins are in the jar?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Autnie Jean is saving all her $5 \ \text{p}$ coins in a jar.
<emptyline>
The total amount of money in the jar is  $\pounds 18.55$.
<emptyline>
How many coins are in the jar?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total coins}     &= \dfrac {\pounds 18.55} {5 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1855 \ \text{p}} {5 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 371} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 371} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                        &= 371
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A group of $30$ adults and $16$ children paid  $\pounds 408$ in total to 
watch a football match. Each child ticket cost  $\pounds 3$.

What was the cost of each adult ticket?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A group of $30$ adults and $16$ children paid  $\pounds 408$ in total to 
watch a football match. Each child ticket cost  $\pounds 3$.
<emptyline>
What was the cost of each adult ticket?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of an adult ticket (in $\pounds$) $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
30 \times a + 16 \times 3   &= 408 \\\\
30a + 48                    &= 408 \\\\
30a                         &= 408 - 48 \\\\
30a                         &= 360 \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {360} {30} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {12 \times 30} {30} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {12 \times \cancel {30}} {\cancel {30}} \\\\
a                           &= \pounds 12
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of an adult ticket $= \pounds 12$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 12$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

In a sale, prices are reduced by $15 \%$.

What is the sale price of a hoody that originally cost  $\pounds 30?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a sale, prices are reduced by $15 \%$.
<emptyline>
What is the sale price of a hoody that originally cost  $\pounds 30?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the price is reduced by $15 \%$, then the sale price will be $100 - 15 = 85 \%$ of the original price.

Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sale price}      &= 85 \% \ \text {of} \ 30 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{85}{100} \times 30 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{85 \times 30}{100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{2550}{100} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 25.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 25.50$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Guy has twice as many stickers as Asif and five more than Kayal.

They have $35$ stickers altogether.

How many stickers does Guy have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Guy has twice as many stickers as Asif and five more than Kayal.
<emptyline>
They have $35$ stickers altogether.
<emptyline>
How many stickers does Guy have?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of stickers Asif has $= a$

Number of stickers Guy has $= 2a$

Number of stickers Kyal has $= 2a - 5$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 2a + 2a - 5             &= 35 \\\\
5a                          &= 35 + 5 \\\\
5a                          &= 40 \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {40}{5} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {5 \times 8}{5} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 8}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
a                           &= 8 \\\\
\text{Stickers Guy has}     &= 2a \\\\
                            &= 2 \times 8 \\\\
                            &= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the number of stickers Asif has $= a$
<emptyline>
Number of stickers Guy has $= 2a$
<emptyline>
Number of stickers Kyal has $= 2a - 5$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
a + 2a + 2a - 5             &= 35 \\\\
5a                          &= 35 + 5 \\\\
5a                          &= 40 \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {40}{5} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {5 \times 8}{5} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 8}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
a                           &= 8 \\\\
\text{Stickers Guy has}     &= 2a \\\\
                            &= 2 \times 8 \\\\
                            &= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

**Question**

I set off with a $\pounds 10$ note to buy a book 
costing $\pounds 4.95$, a cake costing $\pounds 1.30$ and a new pen. 
I got $\pounds 2.25$ change. 

How much did the pen cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I set off with a $\pounds 10$ note to buy a book 
costing $\pounds 4.95$, a cake costing $\pounds 1.30$ and a new pen. 
I got $\pounds 2.25$ change. 
<emptyline>
How much did the pen cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of pen}     &= 10 - 4.95 - 1.30 - 2.25 \\\\
                        &= 5.05 - 1.30 - 2.25 \\\\
                        &= 3.75 - 2.25 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

Auntie Jean is saving all her $5 \ \text{p}$ coins in a jar. 

The total amount of money in the jar is $\pounds 18.55$. 

How many coins are in the jar?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Auntie Jean is saving all her $5 \ \text{p}$ coins in a jar.

The total amount of money in the jar is $\pounds 18.55$. 
<emptyline>
How many coins are in the jar?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Total coins}     &= \dfrac {\pounds 18.55} {5 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1855 \ \text{p}} {5 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 371} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 371} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                        &= 371 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A group of $30$ adults and $16$ children paid $\pounds 408$ in total to watch a football match. 
Each child ticket cost $\pounds 3$.

What was the cost of each adult ticket?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A group of $30$ adults and $16$ children paid $\pounds 408$ in total to watch a football match. 
Each child ticket cost $\pounds 3$.
<emptyline>
What was the cost of each adult ticket?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of an adult ticket $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
30 a + 16 \times 3          &= 408 \\\\
30a + 48                    &= 408 \\\\
30a                         &= 408 - 48 \\\\
30a                         &= 360 \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {360} {30} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {12 \times 30} {30} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {12 \times \cancel {30}} {\cancel {30}} \\\\
a                           &= \pounds 12
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of an adult ticket $= \pounds 12$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a sale, prices are reduced by $15 \%$.

What is the sale price of a hoody that originally cost $\pounds 30?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a sale, prices are reduced by $15 \%$.
<emptyline>
What is the sale price of a hoody that originally cost $\pounds 30?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the price is reduced by $15 \%$, then the sale price will be $100 - 15 = 85 \%$ of the original price.

Using this we get,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sale price}   &= 85 \% \ \text {of} \ 30 \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {85} {100} \times 30 \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {85 \times 30} {100} \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {2550} {100} \\\\
                     &= \pounds 25.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 25.50$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Guy has twice as many stickers as Asif and five more than Kayal. 

They have $35$ stickers altogether.

How many stickers does Guy have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Guy has twice as many stickers as Asif and five more than Kayal. 
<emptyline>
They have $35$ stickers altogether.
<emptyline>
How many stickers does Guy have?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of stickers Asif has $= a$

Number of stickers Guy has $= 2a$

Number of stickers Kyal has $= 2a - 5$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 2a + 2a - 5             &= 35 \\\\
5a                          &= 35 + 5 \\\\
5a                          &= 40 \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {40}{5} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {5 \times 8}{5} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 8}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
a                           &= 8 \\\\
\text{Stickers Guy has}     &= 2a \\\\
                            &= 2 \times 8 \\\\
                            &= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I have $\pounds 45$ in $5 \ \text{p}$ coins. How many $5 \ \text{p}$ coins is that?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I have $\pounds 45$ in $5 \ \text{p}$ coins. How many $5 \ \text{p}$ coins is that?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of coins}     &= \dfrac {\pounds 45} {5 \ \text {p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {45 \times 100 \ \text {p}} {5 \ \text {p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {4500 \ \text {p}} {5 \ \text {p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {900 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {900 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                            &= 900
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$900$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Neruka bought a pen costing $\pounds 4.93$, a pencil costing $24 \ \text{p}$ and a ruler costing $58 \ \text{p}$. How much did she spend altogether?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$

**Question**

Find the smallest amount of money that cannot be paid using three or fewer British coins.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A can of lemonade from a vending machine costs $65 \ \text{p}$. 
The table below shows the coins that were collected from the machine in one day.

|      Coins      | Number of Coins |
|:---------------:|:---------------:|
| $50 \ \text{p}$   |      $22$       |
| $20 \ \text{p}$   |      $18$       |
| $10 \ \text{p}$   |      $33$       |
|  $5 \ \text{p}$   |      $41$       |

How many cans of lemonade were sold that day?

-   $\pounds 20.85$ 
-   $\pounds 19.95$
-   $31$ 
-   $30$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A can of lemonade from a vending machine costs $65 \ \text{p}$. 
The table below shows the coins that were collected from the machine in one day.
<emptyline>
|      Coins      | Number of Coins |
|:---------------:|:---------------:|
| $50 \ \text{p}$   |      $22$       |
| $20 \ \text{p}$   |      $18$       |
| $10 \ \text{p}$   |      $33$       |
|  $5 \ \text{p}$   |      $41$       |
<emptyline>
How many cans of lemonade were sold that day?
<emptyline>
-   $\pounds 20.85$ 
-   $\pounds 19.95$
-   $31$ 
-   $30$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total money}             &= 22 \times 50 + 18 \times 20 + 33 \times 10 + 41 \times 5 \\\\
                                &= 1100 + 360 + 330 + 205 \\\\
                                &= 1995 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Number of cans sold}     &= \dfrac {1995} {65} \\\\
                                &= 30 \ \text {remainder} \ 5 \\\\
                                &\approx 30
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$30$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A can of lemonade from a vending machine costs $65 \ \text{p}$. The table below shows the coins that were collected from the machine in one day.

|      Coins      | Number of Coins |
|:---------------:|:---------------:|
|  $50 \ \text{p}$  |      $22$       |
|  $20 \ \text{p}$  |      $18$       |
|  $10 \ \text{p}$  |      $33$       |
|  $5 \ \text{p}$   |      $41$       |

How many cans of lemonade were sold that day?

- $\pounds 20.85 $
- $\pounds 19.95 $ 
- $31$ 
- $30$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A can of lemonade from a vending machine costs $65 \ \text{p}$. The table below shows the coins that were collected from the machine in one day.
<emptyline>
|      Coins      | Number of Coins |
|:---------------:|:---------------:|
|  $50 \ \text{p}$  |      $22$       |
|  $20 \ \text{p}$  |      $18$       |
|  $10 \ \text{p}$  |      $33$       |
|  $5 \ \text{p}$   |      $41$       |
<emptyline>
How many cans of lemonade were sold that day?
<emptyline>
- $\pounds 20.85 $
- $\pounds 19.95 $ 
- $31$ 
- $30$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total money}         &= 22 \times 50 + 18 \times 20 + 33 \times 10 + 41 \times 5 \\\\
                            &= 1100 + 360 + 330 + 205 \\\\
                            &= 1995 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Number of cans sold} &= \dfrac {1995} {65} \\\\
                            &= 30 \ \text {remainder} \ 5 \\\\
                            &\approx 30
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<p>D</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$30$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I buy $7$ drinks at $72\ \text{p}$ each, and $9$ sandwiches at $\pounds 1.21$ each. 

How much change do I get from a $\pounds 20$ note? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I buy $7$ drinks at $72\ \text{p}$ each, and $9$ sandwiches at $\pounds 1.21$ each. 
<emptyline>
How much change do I get from a $\pounds 20$ note? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}         &= 7 \times 72 \ \text{p} +  9 \times \pounds 1.21 \\\\
                            &= 7 \times \pounds 0.72 + 9 \times \pounds 1.21 \\\\
                            &= 5.04 + 10.89 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 15.93 \\\\
\text {Change received}     &= 20 - 15.93 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 4.07
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 4.07$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Billy went shopping and bought $3$ computer games that cost $\pounds 25.50$ each and $2$ doughnuts that cost $\pounds 1.30$ each.

How much change did Billy get from $\pounds 100?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Billy went shopping and bought $3$ computer games that cost $\pounds 25.50$ each and $2$ doughnuts that cost $\pounds 1.30$ each.
<emptyline>
How much change did Billy get from $\pounds 100?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}         &= 3 \times 25.50 + 2 \times 1.30 \\\\
                            &= 76.50 + 2.60 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 79.10 \\\\
\text {Change received}     &= 100 - 79.10 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 20.90
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 20.90$

**Question**

The total cost for the Bryant family is $\pounds 25$. How many adults and how many children are in the family?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The total cost for the Bryant family is $\pounds 25$. How many adults and how many children are in the family?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
25          &= 8a + 3k \\\\
3k          &= 25 - 8a \\\\
k           &= \dfrac {25 - 8a} {3}
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the answer by using trial and error.

| $a$ (adults) |        $k = \dfrac{25 - 8a}{3}$                | $k$ whole number? |
|:------------:|:---------------------------------------------:|:------------------:|
| $1$          | $\dfrac {25 - 8 \times 1} {3} = \dfrac {17} {3} = 5.67$ | No                |
| $2$          | $\dfrac {25 - 8 \times 2} {3} = \dfrac {9} {3} = 3$     | Yes              |
| $3$          | $\dfrac {25 - 8 \times 3} {3} = \dfrac {1} {3} = 0.33$  | No                |

Adults $= 2$

Using $a = 2$ in the equation for $k$,

$
\begin{aligned}
k           &= \dfrac {25 - 8a} {3} \\\\
k           &= \dfrac {25 - 8 \times 2} {3} \\\\
k           &= \dfrac {25 - 16} {3} \\\\
k           &= \dfrac {9} {3} \\\\
k           &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Children $= 3$
</div>

adults $=$ $2$

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

children $=$ $3$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Refer to the following school canteen price list for this question:

|Pasta Salad  |$95 \ \text{p}$|
|:---:|:----:|
|Baguette  |$85 \ \text{p}$|
|Apple  |$40 \ \text{p}$|
|Fruit Crumble  |$\pounds 1.15$|
|Curry and Rice  |$\pounds 2.30$|

Mr. Sanders wants to buy a class set of $25$ packed lunches - each with a pasta salad, a baguette and an apple.

How much will he have to pay in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Refer to the following school canteen price list for this question:

|Pasta Salad  |$95 \ \text{p}$|
|:---:|:----:|
|Baguette  |$85 \ \text{p}$|
|Apple  |$40 \ \text{p}$|
|Fruit Crumble  |$\pounds 1.15$|
|Curry and Rice  |$\pounds 2.30$|
<emptyline>

<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total cost}  &= 25 \times (95 + 85 + 40) \\\\
                    &= 25 \times 220  \\\\
                    &= 5500 \ \text{p}  \\\\
                    &= \pounds 55
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 55$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

TJ also has two types of cereal snacks: raisin bars and nut bars. Each raisin bar is $12 \ \text{p}$ 
more to buy than a nut bar. Nine raisin bars and twelve nut bars cost $\pounds 5.28$.

How much more do nine raisin bars cost than nine nut bars?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">TJ also has two types of cereal snacks: raisin bars and nut bars. Each raisin bar is $12 \ \text{p}$ 
more to buy than a nut bar. Nine raisin bars and twelve nut bars cost $\pounds 5.28$.
<emptyline>
How much more do nine raisin bars cost than nine nut bars?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

We know that each raisin bar costs $12 \ \text{p}$ more than a nut bar.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Difference}                          &= 9 \times 12 \\\\
                                            &= 108 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 1.08
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.08$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much does a raisin bar cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much does a raisin bar cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a nut bar (in pence) $= a$

Cost of a raisin bar (in pence) $= a + 12$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
9 \times (a + 12) + 12 \times a     &= \pounds 5.28 \\\\
9a + 108 + 12a                      &= 528 \ \text{p} \\\\
21a + 108                           &= 528 \\\\
21a                                 &= 528 - 108 \\\\
21a                                 &= 420 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {420} {21} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {20 \times 21} {21} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel {21}} {\cancel {21}} \\\\
a                                   &= 20 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Cost of raisin bar}          &= a + 12 \\\\
                                    &= 20 + 12 \\\\
                                    &= 32 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$32 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

A coat costing $\pounds 62$ is reduced in a sale by $\pounds 12.40$. 

What percentage discount is this?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A coat costing $\pounds 62$ is reduced in a sale by $\pounds 12.40$. 
<emptyline>
What percentage discount is this?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {\% Discount}     &= \dfrac {\text {Discount}} {\text {Original price}} \times 100 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {12.40} {62} \times 100 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {12.40 \times 100} {62} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {1240} {62} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {62 \times 20} {62} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel{62} \times 20} {\cancel{62}} \\\\
                                &= 20 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20 \%$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ola is planning to complete a sponsored run for Red Nose Day.

He collected a number of different promises, from his family, on his sponsor form.

|    Mum    |                                             $50 \ \text{p}$ per completed mile                                               |
|:---------:|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:|
|    Dad    |                                     $ \pounds 5$ plus $25 \ \text{p}$ per completed mile                                     |
|    Nan    |                                                       $ \pounds 10$                                                        |
|  Grandad  | $10 \ \text{p}$ for the first mile, $20 \ \text{p}$ for the second mile, $30 \ \text{p}$ for the third mile, and so on $ \ldots $|
| Uncle Jay |                                                       $\pounds 15$                                                         |

He hopes to complete either $8$ or $10 \ \text{miles}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ola is planning to complete a sponsored run for Red Nose Day.
<emptyline>

<emptyline>

**Question**

How much extra will Ola collect, in total, if he completes the extra $2 \ \text{miles}$ and runs $10 \ \text{miles}$ (rather than $8 \ \text{miles}$)?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much extra will Ola collect, in total, if he completes the extra $2 \ \text{miles}$ and runs $10 \ \text{miles}$ (rather than $8 \ \text{miles}$)?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money from mum}      &= 10 \times 50  \\\\
                            &= 500 \ \text{p}  \\\\
                            &= \pounds 5 \\\\
\text {Money from dad}      &= \pounds 5 + 10 \times 25 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 5 + 10 \times \pounds 0.25 \\\\
                            &= 5 + 2.50 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 7.50 \\\\
\text {Money from grandad}  &= 360  + 90  + 100  \\\\
                            &= 550 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 5.50 \\\\
\text {Money collected}     &= \text{Mum} + \text{Dad} + \text{Nan} + \text{Grandad} + \text{Uncle} \\\\
                            &= 5 + 7.50 + 10 + 5.50 + 15 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 43 \\\\
\text {Extra money}         &= 43 - 39.60 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 3.40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much change would there be from a $\pounds 20$ note for Alice, Owen, Mum, Dad and Gran if they use the car park?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                        &= \pounds 11.90 \\\\

                        &= \pounds 8.10
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $\ \pounds 4.48?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of $\ \pounds 4.48?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text {of} \ \pounds 4.48 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {4} \times 4.48 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 4.48} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {13.44} {4} \\\\
&= \pounds 3.36
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I buy $13$ chocolate bars costing $23 \ \text{p}$ each. How much change would I get from $\pounds 5?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I buy $13$ chocolate bars costing $23 \ \text{p}$ each. How much change would I get from $\pounds 5?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total cost}      &= 13 \times 23 \\\\
                        &= 299 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 2.99 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 5 - 2.99 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 2.01
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 2.01$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What percentage of $\pounds 5$ is $\pounds 1?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What percentage of $\pounds 5$ is $\pounds 1?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage}               &= \dfrac {1} {5} \times 100 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {100} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {5 \times 20} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 20} {\cancel{5}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 20} {\cancel{5}} \\\\
                                &= 20 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20 \%$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much change would you get from $\pounds 10$ if you bought $7$ $\text{Chocco}^{\text{TM}}$ bars at $78 \ \text{p}$ each?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much change would you get from $\pounds 10$ if you bought $7$ $\text{Chocco}^{\text{TM}}$ bars at $78 \ \text{p}$ each?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned} 
\text {Money spent}             &= 7 \times 78 \\\\
                                &= 546 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                &= \pounds 5.46 \\\\
\text {Change recieved}         &= 10 - 5.46 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 4.54
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 4.54$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $15 \%$ of $\pounds 120?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $15 \%$ of $\pounds 120?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 15 \% \ \text {of} \ \pounds 120 \\\\
&= \dfrac {15} {100} \times 120 \\\\
&= \dfrac {15 \times 120} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 5 \times 6 \times 20} {5 \times 20} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {5} \times 6 \times \cancel {20}} {\cancel {5} \times \cancel {20}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 6 \\\\
&= \pounds 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 18$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A multipack of $12$ cans of Ned's Cola costs $\pounds 6.95$. 

A single can of Ned's Cola costs $65 \ \text{pence}$ if bought individually. 

Calculate how much cheaper it is to buy a multipack of $12$ cans than to buy $12$ cans individually, giving your answer in pence.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A multipack of $12$ cans of Ned's Cola costs $\pounds 6.95$. 
<emptyline>
A single can of Ned's Cola costs $65 \ \text{pence}$ if bought individually. 
<emptyline>
Calculate how much cheaper it is to buy a multipack of $12$ cans than to buy $12$ cans individually, giving your answer in pence.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of 12 cans}                 &= 12 \times 65 \\\\
                                        &= 780 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Cheaper by}                      &= 780 \ \text{p} - \pounds 6.95 \\\\
                                        &= 780 \ \text{p} - 695 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                        &= 85 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$85 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A multipack of $15$ packets of crisps costs $\pounds 3.90$.

A packet of crisps costs $35 \ \text{pence}$ if they are bought individually.

Calculate how much cheaper it is to buy a multipack of $15$ packets of crisps than to buy $15$ packets individually.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

<emptyline>

<emptyline>
Calculate how much cheaper it is to buy a multipack of $15$ packets of crisps than to buy $15$ packets individually.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of 15 packets}  &= 15 \times 35 \\\\
                            &= 525 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Cheaper by}          &= 525 \ \text{p} - \pounds 3.90 \\\\
                            &= 525 \ \text{p} - 390 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= 135 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 1.35
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

She then worked out that if she bought only $5$ lollipops, she would have exactly the right amount of money left over to buy $3$ packets of jelly gums.

Work out the price of one packet of jelly gum.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of 5 lollipops}     &= 5 \times 35 \\\\
                                &= 175 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Cost of 3 jelly gums}    &= 310 - 175 \\\\
\text {Cost of 1 jelly gums}    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times (310 - 175) \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {135} {3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {45 \times 3} {3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {45 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
                                &= 45 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jon has $30\%$ more money than Miguel and together they have $\pounds 46$. Calculate how much money Jon has. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jon has $30\%$ more money than Miguel and together they have $\pounds 46$. Calculate how much money Jon has. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let Miguel has (in $\pounds$) $= a$

Jon has (in $\pounds$) $= a + 0.3 \times a = 1.3a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 1.3a                        &= 46 \\\\
2.3a                            &= 46 \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {46} {2.3} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {46 \times 10} {23} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {23 \times 2 \times 10} {23} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {\cancel{23} \times 2 \times 10} {\cancel{23}} \\\\
a                               &= 2 \times 10 \\\\
a                               &= \pounds 20 \\\\
\text {Jon has}                 &= 1.3 \times a \\\\
                                &= 1.3 \times 20 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 26
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 26$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A drink and a box of popcorn together cost $90 \ \text{p}$. Two drinks and a box of popcorn together cost $\pounds 1.45$. What does a box of popcorn cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A drink and a box of popcorn together cost $90 \ \text{p}$. Two drinks and a box of popcorn together cost $\pounds 1.45$. What does a box of popcorn cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 drink}  &= \pounds 1.45 - 90 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 145 \ \text{p} - 90 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 55 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Cost of popcorn}  &= 90 - 55  \\\\
                        &= 35 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Maggie buys

$1 \dfrac{1}{2} \ \text{kg}$ of carrots at $64 \ \text{p}$ per kg,

$4$ cakes at $35 \ \text{p}$ each,

$6$ tins of soup at $43 \ \text{p}$ each.

She pays with a $\pounds 10$ note.

Work out how much change she should get. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Maggie buys
<emptyline>
$1 \dfrac{1}{2} \ \text{kg}$ of carrots at $64 \ \text{p}$ per kg,
<emptyline>
$4$ cakes at $35 \ \text{p}$ each,
<emptyline>
$6$ tins of soup at $43 \ \text{p}$ each.
<emptyline>
She pays with a $\pounds 10$ note.
<emptyline>
Work out how much change she should get. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 1 \dfrac {1} {2} \times 64 + 4 \times 35 + 6 \times 43 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 64} {2} + 4 \times 35 + 6 \times 43 \\\\
                        &= 3 \times 32 + 4 \times 35 + 6 \times 43 \\\\
                        &= 96 + 140 + 258 \\\\
                        &= 494 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.94 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 10 - 4.94 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 5.06
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 5.06$

</div>
</div>

Laura's family wins $\pounds 54$ in a raffle. They give $\pounds 12$ to charity and share the rest equally between the 
five family members. How much does each family member get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

                                &= \dfrac {42} {5} \\\\
                                &= \pounds 8.40
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

The charity spends $60\%$ of the donation on buying equipment. How much of the donation is not spent?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The charity spends $60\%$ of the donation on buying equipment. How much of the donation is not spent?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the charity spends $60 \%$ on equipments, then the donation not spent is $100 - 60 = 40 \%$.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Donation not spent}   &= 40 \% \ \text {of} \ \pounds 12 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {40} {100} \times 12 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {40 \times 12} {100} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {480} {100} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 4.80
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
