<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Theo bought a choclate bar for $72\ \text{p}$ and some balloons, each of which cost $20\ \text{p}$. He paid with a $\pounds10$ note and recieved $\pounds3.88$. How many balloons did he buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Theo bought a choclate bar for $72\ \text{p}$ and some balloons, each of which cost $20\ \text{p}$. He paid with a $\pounds10$ note and recieved $\pounds3.88$. How many balloons did he buy?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money spent}          &= 10 - 3.88 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 6.12 \\\\
                            &= 612 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Cost of balloons}     &= 612 - 72 \\\\
                            &= 540 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Number of balloons}   &= \dfrac{540}{20} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{20 \times 27}{20} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{\cancel{20} \times 27}{\cancel{20}} \\\\
                            &= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculators normally cost $\pounds 6$ and protractors normally cost $30 \ \text{p}$.

In a sale, calculators have been reduced by a quarter and protractors are half price.

David bought $8$ calculators and $20$ protractors.

How much did he have to pay? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculators normally cost $\pounds 6$ and protractors normally cost $30 \ \text{p}$.
<emptyline>
In a sale, calculators have been reduced by a quarter and protractors are half price.
<emptyline>
David bought $8$ calculators and $20$ protractors.
<emptyline>
How much did he have to pay? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the calculator cost is reduced by one quarter, then the new cost will be $1 - \dfrac {1} {4} = \dfrac {3} {4}$ of the original cost.

If the protractor cost is reduced by half, then the new cost will be $1 - \dfrac {1} {2} = \dfrac {1} {2}$ of the original cost.

Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost}   &= 8 \times \dfrac {3} {4} \times \pounds 6 + 20 \times \dfrac {1} {2} \times 30 \ \text{p} \\\\
                    &= 8 \times \dfrac{3}{4} \times \pounds 6 + 20 \times \dfrac {1} {2} \times \pounds 0.30 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{8 \times 3 \times 6}{4} + \dfrac {20 \times 0.3}{2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{4 \times 2 \times 3 \times 6}{4} + \dfrac {10 \times 2 \times 0.3}{2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{\cancel{4} \times 2 \times 3 \times 6}{\cancel{4}} + \dfrac {10 \times \cancel{2} \times 0.3}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
                    &= 2 \times 3 \times 6 + 10 \times 0.3 \\\\
                    &= 36 + 3 \\\\
                    &= \pounds 39
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 39$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

*SPECIAL OFFER ON THE MATHS BOOKS!*

*Fun Trignometric Calculus For Pre-School, by Ian Tregation*

*Only $\pounds16$ each.*

*Special offer: Buy $3$ and get $1$ free!*

Subhan wants to get $5$ of these books.

How much does he pay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">*SPECIAL OFFER ON THE MATHS BOOKS!*
<emptyline>
*Fun Trignometric Calculus For Pre-School, by Ian Tregation*
<emptyline>
*Only $\pounds16$ each.*
<emptyline>
*Special offer: Buy $3$ and get $1$ free!*
<emptyline>
Subhan wants to get $5$ of these books.
<emptyline>
How much does he pay?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If Subhan buys $3$ book, he gets the $4 ^ \text{th}$ book free. And then he pays for $5 ^ \text{th}$ book.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Anokhi buys $4$ chocolate bars at $75 \ \text{p}$ each and $3$ pens at $95 \ \text{p}$ each.
How much change does she receive from a $\pounds10$ note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Anokhi buys $4$ chocolate bars at $75 \ \text{p}$ each and $3$ pens at $95 \ \text{p}$ each.
How much change does she receive from a $\pounds10$ note?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 4 \times 75 + 3 \times 95 \\\\
                        &= 300 + 285 \\\\
                        &= 585 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 5.85 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 10 - 5.85 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 4.15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Gurveen is buying paint and there are three sizes of can to choose from:

One $2 \ \text{litre}$ can cost $\pounds 15$

One $3 \ \text{litre}$ can cost $\pounds20$

One $4 \ \text{litre}$ can cost $\pounds25$

Which size is the best value for money?

Justify your answer carefully.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Gurveen is buying paint and there are three sizes of can to choose from:
<emptyline>
One $2 \ \text{litre}$ can cost $\pounds 15$
<emptyline>
One $3 \ \text{litre}$ can cost $\pounds20$
<emptyline>
One $4 \ \text{litre}$ can cost $\pounds25$
<emptyline>
Which size is the best value for money?
<emptyline>
Justify your answer carefully.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's calculate the cost per litre for the three sizes.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {First can}   &= \dfrac {15} {2} \\\\
                    &= \pounds 7.50 \\\\
\text {Second can}  &= \dfrac {20} {3} \\\\
                    &= \pounds 6.33 \\\\
\text {Third can}   &= \dfrac {25} {4} \\\\
                    &= \pounds 6.25
\end{aligned}
$

Best value $= 4 \ \text {litre}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4 \ \text {litre}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many $\pounds 5$ notes are needed to make $\pounds 1000$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many $\pounds 5$ notes are needed to make $\pounds 1000$?
</code></pre>

                        &= \dfrac {200 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {200 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                        &= 200
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much change would I get from $\pounds 20$ if I bought $3$ pens at $\pounds 1.60$ each, $2$ pencils at $62\ \text{p}$ and a magazine for $\pounds4.50$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 3 \times \pounds 1.60 + 2 \times 62 \ \text{p} + \pounds 4.50 \\\\
                        &= 3 \times \pounds 1.60 + 2 \times \pounds 0.62 + \pounds 4.50 \\\\
                        &= 4.80 + 1.24 + 4.50 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 10.54 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 20 - 10.54 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 9.46
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A maths book cost $\pounds 15.49$. How much change do you get if you pay only with $\pounds 1$ coins?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                        &= \pounds 16 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 16 - 15.49 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 0.51 \\\\
                        &= 51 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Janice wants to buy as many cookies as she can afford with a $\pounds 10$ note. Each cookie costs $70 \ \text{p}$. 
How much change will she receive? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Janice wants to buy as many cookies as she can afford with a $\pounds 10$ note. Each cookie costs $70 \ \text{p}$. 
How much change will she receive? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total cookies she can buy}   &= \dfrac {\pounds 10} {70 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {1000 \ \text{p}} {70 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                    &= 14 \text{ remainder } 20 \\\\
                                    &\approx 14 \\\\
\text {Change received}             &= 20 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

$20 \ \text{p}$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Karim buys $7$ burgers and $5$ steaks. Burgers cost $61 \ \text{p}$ each and steaks cost $84 \ \text{p}$ each.

How much Karim spend in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Karim buys $7$ burgers and $5$ steaks. Burgers cost $61 \ \text{p}$ each and steaks cost $84 \ \text{p}$ each.
<emptyline>
How much Karim spend in total?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 7 \times 61  + 5 \times 84  \\\\
                        &= 427 + 420 \\\\
                        &= 847 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 8.47
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 8.47$

**Question**

Sausages come in packs of $8$. Each pack costs $\pounds 1.30$.

James spends $\pounds 9.10$ on sausages. How much sausages did James get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sausages come in packs of $8$. Each pack costs $\pounds 1.30$.
<emptyline>
James spends $\pounds 9.10$ on sausages. How much sausages did James get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total packs}                 &= \dfrac {9.10} {1.30}  \\\\
\text {Total sausages}              &= \dfrac {9.10} {1.30} \times 8 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {9.10 \times 100 \times 8} {1.30 \times 100}  \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {910 \times 8} {130} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 130 \times 8} {130} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {130} \times 8} {\cancel {130}} \\\\
                                    &= 7 \times 8 \\\\
                                    &= 56
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$56$ 

</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total packs}                 &= \dfrac {9.10} {1.30}  \\\\

                                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 130 \times 8} {130} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {130} \times 8} {\cancel {130}} \\\\
                                    &= 7 \times 8 \\\\
                                    &= 56
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The butcher also sells slices of turkey.

Donald buys three quarters of the slices in the shop. Alisha then buys a sixth of the remaining slices.

Alisha bought $3$ slices. How many more slices than Alisha did Donald buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The butcher also sells slices of turkey.
<emptyline>
Donald buys three quarters of the slices in the shop. Alisha then buys a sixth of the remaining slices.
<emptyline>
Alisha bought $3$ slices. How many more slices than Alisha did Donald buy?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let total number of slices $= a$

Number of slices Donald bought $= \dfrac {3a} {4}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {6} \times (a - \dfrac {3a} {4}) &= 3\\\\
a - \dfrac {3a} {4}                        &= 3 \times 6\\\\
\dfrac {a \times 4} {4} - \dfrac {3a} {4}   &= 3 \times 6 \\\\
\dfrac {4a} {4} - \dfrac {3a} {4}           &= 3 \times 6 \\\\
\dfrac {4a - 3a} {4}                        &= 3 \times 6 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                            &= 3 \times 6 \\\\
a                                          &= 3 \times 6 \times 4 \\\\
a                                          &= 72 \\\\
\text {Slices Donald bought}               &= \dfrac {3a} {4} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {3 \times 72} {4} \\\\
                                           &= 54 \\\\
\text {Difference}                         &= 54 - 3 \\\\
                                           &= 51
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$51$

</div>
</div>

Lamb chops are three times more expensive than pork chops.

Tina buys $2$ lamb chops and $2$ pork chops. She spends $\pounds 9.60$ in total.

How much do lamb chops and pork chops cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>

a                           &= \dfrac {9.60} {8} \\\\
a                           &= \pounds 1.20
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}

\text {Cost of a lamb chop} &= 3a \\\\
                            &= 3 \times 1.20 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 3.60
\end{aligned}
$

How many potatoes can Stanley buy, and how much money does he have left over?

</div>

                                    &= \dfrac {320 \ \text{p}} {56 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {8 \times 40} {8 \times 7} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {8} \times 40} {\cancel {8} \times 7} \\\\

\end{aligned}

**Question**

$5$ giant mushrooms cost the same as $3$ cucumbers.
Marvin buys $12$ cucumbers for $\pounds 3.60$.

What is the cost of $8$ giant mushrooms?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$5$ giant mushrooms cost the same as $3$ cucumbers.
Marvin buys $12$ cucumbers for $\pounds 3.60$.
<emptyline>
What is the cost of $8$ giant mushrooms?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of cucumber}         &= \dfrac {\pounds 3.60} {12} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {3.60 \times 100 \ \text{p}} {12} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {360} {12} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {12 \times 30} {12} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {12} \times 30} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
                                &= 30 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

if $5$ mushrooms cost the same as $3$ cucumbers, then the cost of $1$ mushroom is $\dfrac {3} {5}$ of the cost of a cucumber.

Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of 1 mushroom}      &= \dfrac {3} {5} \times 30 \\\\
\text {Cost of 8 mushrooms}     &= 8 \times \dfrac {3} {5} \times 30 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 30} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 6 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 6 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}} \\\\
                                &= 144 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                &= \pounds 1.44
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.44$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$

                                &= \dfrac {3.60 \times 100 \ \text{p}} {12} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {360} {12} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {12 \times 30} {12} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {12} \times 30} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
                                &= 30 \ \text{p}

$
<emptyline>
if $5$ mushrooms cost the same as $3$ cucumbers, then the cost of $1$ mushroom is $\dfrac {3} {5}$ of the cost of a cucumber.
<emptyline>
Using that, we get
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of 1 mushroom}      &= \dfrac {3} {5} \times 30 \\\\
\text {Cost of 8 mushrooms}     &= 8 \times \dfrac {3} {5} \times 30 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 30} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 6 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 6 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}} \\\\
                                &= 144 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                &= \pounds 1.44
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Asha sells vegetables at the market. On Monday she sold half of her vegetables. On Tuesday she sold a third of the vegetables she had 
left.

What fraction of her original stock does she have left to sell on Wednesday?


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Asha sells vegetables at the market. On Monday she sold half of her vegetables. On Tuesday she sold a third of the vegetables she had 
left.
<emptyline>
What fraction of her original stock does she have left to sell on Wednesday?
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the original stock of vegetables $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Vegetables sold on Monday}          &= \dfrac {a} {2} \\\\
\text {Vegetables sold on Tuesday}         &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times (a - \dfrac {a} {2}) \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {a} {2} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {a} {6} \\\\
\text {Vegetables left to sell on Wednesday}    &= a - \dfrac {a} {2} - \dfrac {a} {6} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {a \times 6} {6} - \dfrac {a \times 3} {2 \times 3} - \dfrac {a} {6} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {6a - 3a - a} {6} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {2a} {6} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {a} {3} \\\\
\text {Fraction of vegetables left}             &= \dfrac {\text{Vegetables left}} {\text{Total vegetables}} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {a} {3} \div a \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {a} {3 \times a} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel{a}} {3 \times \cancel{a}} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {3}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

A tin of cookies costs $\pounds 3.69$ and a bag of jelly babies cost $\pounds 1.55$. 
Tracey and Cat buy $2$ tins of cookies and a bag of jelly babies. They pay with a $\pounds 20$ note. 
How much change should they get? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A tin of cookies costs $\pounds 3.69$ and a bag of jelly babies cost $\pounds 1.55$. 
Tracey and Cat buy $2$ tins of cookies and a bag of jelly babies. They pay with a $\pounds 20$ note. 
How much change should they get? 
</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                         &= 7.38 + 1.55 \\\\
                         &= \pounds 8.93 \\\\

                         &= \pounds 11.07
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A normal tin contains $40$ cookies. A special offer tin contains $\dfrac{3}{10}$ more cookies. 

Work out how many cookies there are in a special offer tin.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A normal tin contains $40$ cookies. A special offer tin contains $\dfrac{3}{10}$ more cookies. 
<emptyline>
Work out how many cookies there are in a special offer tin.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total Cookies}   &= 40 + \dfrac {3} {10} \ \text {of} \ 40 \\\\
                        &= 40 + \dfrac {3} {10} \times 40 \\\\
                        &= 40 + \dfrac {3 \times 40} {10} \\\\
                        &= 40 + \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 10} {10} \\\\
                        &= 40 + \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel {10}} \\\\
                        &= 40 + 3 \times 4 \\\\
                        &= 40 + 12 \\\\
                        &= 52
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$52$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total Cookies}   &= 40 + \dfrac {3} {10} \ \text {of} \ 40 \\\\
                        &= 40 + \dfrac {3} {10} \times 40 \\\\
                        &= 40 + \dfrac {3 \times 40} {10} \\\\
                        &= 40 + \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 10} {10} \\\\
                        &= 40 + \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel {10}} \\\\
                        &= 40 + 3 \times 4 \\\\
                        &= 40 + 12 \\\\
                        &= 52
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Natalie buys $3$ small bags of peanuts and pays with a $\pounds 2$ coin. 
She receives $80 \ \text{p}$ change. 
How much does each bag cost? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Natalie buys $3$ small bags of peanuts and pays with a $\pounds 2$ coin. 
She receives $80 \ \text{p}$ change. 
How much does each bag cost? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a bag (in pence) $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3a + 80 \ \text{p}   &= \pounds 2 \\\\
3a + 80 \ \text{p}   &= 200 \ \text{p} \\\\
3a                  &= 200 - 80 \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {120} {3} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {3 \times 40} {3} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 40} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
a                   &= 40 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of a bag $= 40 \ \text{p}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$40 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many $26 \ \text{p}$ stamps can Antonia buy for $\pounds 10$ and how much change will she receive? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many $26 \ \text{p}$ stamps can Antonia buy for $\pounds 10$ and how much change will she receive? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                        &= \dfrac {1000 \ \text{p}} {26 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1000} {26} \\\\
                        &= 38 \ \text {remainder} \ 12 \\\\
                        &\approx 38 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 1000 - 38 \times 26 \\\\
                        &= 1000 - 988 \\\\
                        &= 12 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

To encourage her to tidy her bedroom, Cathy is given $1 \ \text{p}$ on the first day, $2 \ \text{p}$ on the second day, $4 \ \text{p}$ on the third day and so on, doubling the amount each day. 
How much has she been given after $8$ days?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">To encourage her to tidy her bedroom, Cathy is given $1 \ \text{p}$ on the first day, $2 \ \text{p}$ on the second day, $4 \ \text{p}$ on the third day and so on, doubling the amount each day. 
How much has she been given after $8$ days?  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text {Total money given}   &= 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 + 16 + 32 + 64 + 128 \\\\
                            &= 255 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 2.55
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Gavin buys four bottles of cola at $\pounds 1.09$ each and $8$ chocolate bars at $62 \ \text{p}$. How much change should he receive from a ten-pound note? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 4 \times \pounds 1.09 + 62 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.36 + \pounds 0.62 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.98 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 10 - 4.98 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 5.02
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

How many times can she visit a side show if she has a cream tea as well?

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Anna has $\pounds 5$ to spend at the school fair. She must pay to get in.

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

_no_dot

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of entry and tea}   &= 20 \ \text{p} + \pounds 2.60 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 0.20 + \pounds 2.60 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 2.80 \\\\
\text {Money left}              &= 5 - 2.80 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 2.20 \\\\
\text {Number of side shows}    &= \dfrac {\pounds 2.20} {30 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {220 \ \text{p}} {30 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {220} {30} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {22 \cancel{0}} {3 \cancel{0}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {22} {3} \\\\
                                &= 7 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                                &\approx 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answers">

$7$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

At a party we ordered $4$ sausage rolls at $24 \ \text{pence}$ each, $5$ hotdogs at $81 \ \text{p}$ each and $7$
drinks at $20 \ \text{pence}$ each.

What is the total cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At a party we ordered $4$ sausage rolls at $24 \ \text{pence}$ each, $5$ hotdogs at $81 \ \text{p}$ each and $7$
drinks at $20 \ \text{pence}$ each.
<emptyline>
What is the total cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total cost}  &= 4 \times 24  + 5 \times 81  + 7 \times 20 \\\\
                    &= 96 + 405 + 140 \\\\
                    &= 641 \ \text {pence} \\\\
                    &= \pounds 6.41
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 6.41$

</div>

&= \dfrac {\cancel {50} \times \cancel {2} \times 29} {\cancel {50} \times \cancel {2}} \\\\
&= 29 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Deirdre has $\pounds  300$ that she wants to turn into dinars. How many dinars will she receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Deirdre has $\pounds  300$ that she wants to turn into dinars. How many dinars will she receive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using above answers,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 24  &= 60 \ \text {dinars} \\\\
\pounds 1   &= \dfrac {60} {24} \ \text {dinars} \\\\
\pounds 300 &= \dfrac {60} {24} \times 300 \text { dinars} \\\\
\pounds 300 &= \dfrac {60 \times 300} {24} \\\\
\pounds 300 &= \dfrac {6 \times 10 \times 4 \times 75} {6 \times 4} \\\\
\pounds 300 &= \dfrac {\cancel {6} \times 10 \times \cancel {4} \times 75} {\cancel {6} \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
\pounds 300 &= 10 \times 75 \\\\
\pounds 300 &= 750 \ \text {dinars}
\end{aligned}
$

Deirdre received $= 750 \ \text {dinars}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$750 \ \text {dinars}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find the greatest number of $28 \ \text{p}$ stamps which can be bought for $\pounds 5$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the greatest number of $28 \ \text{p}$ stamps which can be bought for $\pounds 5$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of stamps}    &= \dfrac {\pounds 5} {28 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {500 \ \text{p}} {28 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {4 \times 125} {4 \times 7} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {4} \times 125} {\cancel {4} \times 7} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {125} {7} \\\\
                            &= 17 \ \text {remainder} \ 6 \\\\
                            &\approx 17
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I buy $3$ chocolate bars for $65\ \text{pence}$ each and $5$ bags of crisps for $55 \ \text{p}$ each. How much change do I get from a $\pounds5$ note?

- $30\ \text{p}$
- $35\ \text{p}$
- $40\ \text{p}$
- $45\ \text{p}$
- $50\ \text{p}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I buy $3$ chocolate bars for $65\ \text{pence}$ each and $5$ bags of crisps for $55 \ \text{p}$ each. How much change do I get from a $\pounds5$ note?
<emptyline>
- $30\ \text{p}$
- $35\ \text{p}$
- $40\ \text{p}$
- $45\ \text{p}$
- $50\ \text{p}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 3 \times 65 + 5 \times 55 \\\\
                        &= 195 + 275 \\\\
                        &= 470 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Change received} &= \pounds 5 - 470 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 500 \ \text{p} - 470 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 30 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Toy cars cost $84\ \text{p}$ each or $\pounds2.20$ for a box of three. What's the largest number of cars I can buy with $\pounds15?$

- $17$
- $18$
- $19$
- $20$
- $21$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Toy cars cost $84\ \text{p}$ each or $\pounds2.20$ for a box of three. What's the largest number of cars I can buy with $\pounds15?$
<emptyline>
- $17$
- $18$
- $19$
- $20$
- $21$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Lets find out how many boxes of $3$ toy cars can be bought, then we find how many individual toy cars can be bought with the remaining money. 

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of boxes}         &= \dfrac {15} {2.20} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {15 \times 10} {2.20 \times 10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {150} {22} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 75} {11 \times 2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 75} {11 \times \cancel {2}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {75} {11} \\\\
                                &= 6 \ \text {remainder} \ 9 \\\\
                                &\approx 6 \\\\
\text {Money spent on boxes}   &= 6 \times \pounds 2.20 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 13.20 \\\\
\text {Money left}   &= \pounds 15 - \pounds 13.20 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 1.80 \\\\
                                &= 180 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Individual toys}         &= \dfrac {180 \ \text{p}} {84 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {12 \times 15} {7 \times 12} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {12} \times 15} {7 \times \cancel {12}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {15} {7} \\\\
                                &= 2 \ \text {remainder} \ 1 \\\\
                                &\approx 2 \\\\
\text {Total number of toys}    &= 3 \times 6 + 2 \\\\
                                &= 18 + 2 \\\\
                                &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>D</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many different ways are there of paying exactly $20\ \text{p}$ using only $1\ \text{p}$ and $2\ \text{p}$ coins?

- $2$
- $11$
- $10$
- $5$
- $20$

- $11$
- $10$
- $5$
- $20$
</code></pre>

| $9$  | $2$  | $9 \times 2 + 2 \times 1 = 20 \ \text{p}$  |
| $10$ | $0$  | $10 \times 2 + 0 \times 1 = 20 \ \text{p}$ |

Total ways $= 11$

**Question**

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I buy $7$ bags of Cheezos at $55\ \text{pence}$ each and $4$ bags of Nuttees at $63\ \text{pence}$ each. How much change do I get from $\pounds{10}?$ 

- $\pounds{3.73}$ 
- $\pounds{3.63}$
- $\pounds{4.73}$ 
- $\pounds{4.63}$ 
- $\pounds{6.37}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                        &= 385 + 252 \\\\
                        &= 637 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 6.37 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 10 - 6.37 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 3.63
\end{aligned}
$

| $1$  | $18$ | $1 \times 10 + 18 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $2$  | $16$ | $2 \times 10 + 16 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $3$  | $14$ | $3 \times 10 + 14 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $4$  | $12$ | $4 \times 10 + 12 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $5$  | $10$ | $5 \times 10 + 10 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $6$  | $8$  | $6 \times 10 + 8 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $7$  | $6$  | $7 \times 10 + 6 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $8$  | $4$  | $8 \times 10 + 4 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $9$  | $2$  | $9 \times 10 + 2 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
| $10$ | $0$  | $10 \times 10 + 0 \times 5 = 100 \ \text{p}$ |
<emptyline>
Total ways $= 11$
</code></pre>

<div class="uuid">
<p>7ED0E8A6-8797-4138-A006-85F2D567D9C5</p>
</div>
<div class="papername">
<p>leicester-high-school-for-girls--11-plus--maths--9999--sample-paper-3:1:8</p>
</div>
<div class="rag">
<p>Waffles Woof</p>

<div class="rag">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mrs Cook's supermarket basket contains: 

$1$ loaf of bread costing $68\ \text{p}$

$1$ packet of cheese costing $\pounds3.29$ 

$5$ packets of crisps at $22\ \text{p}$ each 

$2$ tins of soup at $39\ \text{p}$ each.

Calculate how much change she will receive if she pays with a $\pounds20$ note. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mrs Cook's supermarket basket contains: 
<emptyline>
$1$ loaf of bread costing $68\ \text{p}$
<emptyline>
$1$ packet of cheese costing $\pounds3.29$ 
<emptyline>
$5$ packets of crisps at $22\ \text{p}$ each 
<emptyline>
$2$ tins of soup at $39\ \text{p}$ each.
<emptyline>
Calculate how much change she will receive if she pays with a $\pounds20$ note. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 68 \ \text{p} + \pounds 3.29 + 5 \times 22 \ \text{p} + 2 \times 39 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 0.68 + \pounds 3.29 + 5 \times \pounds 0.22 + 2 \times \pounds 0.39 \\\\
                        &= 0.68 + 3.29 + 1.1 + 0.78 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 5.85 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 20 - 5.85 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 14.15
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

If James buys $5$ pens and $7$ pencils, how much money will he have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If James buys $5$ pens and $7$ pencils, how much money will he have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}             &= 5 \times \pounds 1.25 + 7 \times 80 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                &= 5 \times \pounds 1.25 + 7 \times \pounds 0.80 \\\\
                                &= 6.25 + 5.60 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 11.85 \\\\
\text{Money left}               &= 15 - 11.85 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 3.15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 3.15$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If instead James buys a set of $5$ pencils, what is the maximum number of pens he can buy?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                                         &= \pounds 11 \\\\
\text{Maximum pens} &= \dfrac {11} {1.25} \\\\
                                         &= 8.8 \\\\
                                         &\approx 8
\end{aligned}
$

Maximum pens $= 8$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If instead James ends up with $\pounds 2.80$ left of his money how many pens and how many pencils did he buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If instead James ends up with $\pounds 2.80$ left of his money how many pens and how many pencils did he buy?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of pens $= a$

Let the number of pencils $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
1.25 \times a + 0.80 \times b                   &= 15 - 2.80 \\\\
1.25a + 0.80b                                   &= 12.20 \\\\
100 \times 1.25a + 100 \times 0.80b             &= 100 \times 12.20 \\\\
125a + 80b                                      &= 1220 \\\\
\dfrac {125a} {5} + \dfrac {80b} {5}            &= \dfrac {1220} {5} \\\\
25a + 16b                                       &= 244 \\\\
b                                              &= \dfrac {244 - 25a} {16}
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error.

We try sensible values of $a$. For example, $244 - 25a$ has to be an even number. If it is an odd number, it won't satisfy the equation.

| $a$ (pens) |   $244 - 25a$   | Odd or Even? |  $b$   | $b$ whole number? |
|:----------:|:----------------:|:-------------:|:------------------------:|:------------------:|
|     $1$      | $244 - 25 \times 1 = 219$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
|     $2$      | $244 - 25 \times 2 = 194$ | Even          | $194 \div 16 = 12.12$    | No                |
|     $3$      | $244 - 25 \times 3 = 169$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
|     $4$      | $244 - 25 \times 4 = 144$| Even          | $144 \div 16 = 9$        | Yes              |
|     $5$      | $244 - 25 \times 5 =119$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
|     $6$      | $244 - 25 \times 6 = 94$ | Even          | $94 \div 16 = 5.88$      | No                |
|     $7$      | $244 - 25 \times 7 = 69$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
|     $8$      | $244 - 25 \times 8 = 44$ | Even          | $44 \div 16 = 2.75$      | No                |
|     $9$      | $244 - 25 \times 9 = 19$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |

A quick check shows that $a =4$ and $ b =9$ satisfies the equation above.

Pens $= 4$

Pencils $= 9$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Pencils $=$ $9$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Pens $=$ $4$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the number of pens $= a$
<emptyline>
Let the number of pencils $= b$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
1.25 \times a + 0.80 \times b                   &= 15 - 2.80 \\\\
1.25a + 0.80b                                   &= 12.20 \\\\
100 \times 1.25a + 100 \times 0.80b             &= 100 \times 12.20 \\\\
125a + 80b                                      &= 1220 \\\\
\dfrac {125a} {5} + \dfrac {80b} {5}            &= \dfrac {1220} {5} \\\\
25a + 16b                                       &= 244 \\\\
b                                              &= \dfrac {244 - 25a} {16}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
We can easily infer the values by using trial and error.
<emptyline>
We try sensible values of $a$. For example, $244 - 25a$ has to be an even number. If it is an odd number, it won't satisfy the equation.
<emptyline>
| $a$ (pens) |   $244 - 25a$   | Odd or Even? |  $b$   | $b$ whole number? |
|:----------:|:----------------:|:-------------:|:------------------------:|:------------------:|
|     $1$      | $244 - 25 \times 1 = 219$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
|     $2$      | $244 - 25 \times 2 = 194$ | Even          | $194 \div 16 = 12.12$    | No                |
|     $3$      | $244 - 25 \times 3 = 169$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
|     $4$      | $244 - 25 \times 4 = 144$| Even          | $144 \div 16 = 9$        | Yes              |
|     $5$      | $244 - 25 \times 5 =119$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
|     $6$      | $244 - 25 \times 6 = 94$ | Even          | $94 \div 16 = 5.88$      | No                |
|     $7$      | $244 - 25 \times 7 = 69$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
|     $8$      | $244 - 25 \times 8 = 44$ | Even          | $44 \div 16 = 2.75$      | No                |
|     $9$      | $244 - 25 \times 9 = 19$ | Odd           | —                        | No                |
<emptyline>
A quick check shows that $a =4$ and $ b =9$ satisfies the equation above.
<emptyline>
Pens $= 4$
<emptyline>
Pencils $= 9$
</code></pre>
</div>

Work out the price Mark paid for each melon, in pence.

$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Five of the melons were bad. Mark sold the other $20$ for $120 \ \text{p}$ each.
<emptyline>
Work out the total amount for which Mark sold the melons.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total amount}    &= 20 \times 120 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 2400 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 24$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out what profit Mark made in selling the melons, giving your answer as a fraction of the cost of buying the melons.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out what profit Mark made in selling the melons, giving your answer as a fraction of the cost of buying the melons.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Profit}              &= 24 - 16 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 8 \\\\
\text {Fraction}            &= \dfrac {8} {16} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {8} {8 \times 2} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {8}} {\cancel {8} \times 2} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Susan's bus fare is exactly $44 \ \text{p}$. If the driver can give her change, what is the smallest number of coins that can change hands when Susan pays to get on the bus? (Explain clearly)

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Susan's bus fare is exactly $44 \ \text{p}$. If the driver can give her change, what is the smallest number of coins that can change hands when Susan pays to get on the bus? (Explain clearly)
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- The coins available are: $1 \ \text{p}$, $2 \ \text{p}$, $5 \ \text{p}$, $10 \ \text{p}$, $20 \ \text{p}$, $50 \ \text{p}$, $\pounds 1$, $\pounds 2$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

We can easily infer the answer by using trial and error.

Let’s consider different ways Susan could pay, and how much change the driver gives back.

| Susan pays      | Change given    | Coins changing hands | Remarks                                                                                              |
| :-------------: | :-------------: | :-------------------:| :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| $44 \ \text{p}$ | $0$             | $4$                  | Exact payment: $20 \ \text{p} + 20 \ \text{p} + 2 \ \text{p} + 2 \ \text{p}$                         |
| $45 \ \text{p}$ | $1 \ \text{p}$  | $4$                  | $3$ coins given ($20 \ \text{p} + 20 \ \text{p} + 5 \ \text{p}$), $1$ coin returned ($1 \ \text{p}$) |
| $50 \ \text{p}$ | $6 \ \text{p}$  | $3$                  | $1$ coin given ($50 \ \text{p}$), $2$ coins returned ($5 \ \text{p} + 1 \ \text{p}$)                 |
| $\pounds 1$     | $56 \ \text{p}$ | $5$                  | $1$ coin given ($\pounds 1$), $3$ coins returned ($50 \ \text{p} + 5 \ \text{p} + 1 \ \text{p}$)              |

Smallest number of coins $= 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In March $1998$ a book called “The Shadow of the East” was returned to a library in Sussex. It had been borrowed on January $3 ^\text{rd} ,\ 1924$ 
The library charges a fine of $60 \ \text{p per week}$ for overdue books. Approximately how big a fine should the person who returned the book have paid?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In March $1998$ a book called “The Shadow of the East” was returned to a library in Sussex. It had been borrowed on January $3 ^\text{rd} ,\ 1924$ 
The library charges a fine of $60 \ \text{p per week}$ for overdue books. Approximately how big a fine should the person who returned the book have paid?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total fine}  &= 60 \ \text{p} \times (\text {March} \ 1998 - \text {January} \ 1924) \\\\
                    &= 60 \times (74 \ \text {years} \ 2 \ \text {months}) \\\\
                    &\approx 60 \times (74 \times 58 \ \text {weeks} + 2 \times 4 \ \text {weeks}) \\\\
                    &\approx 60 \times (4292 + 8) \\\\
                    &\approx 60 \times 4300 \\\\
                    &\approx 258000 \ \text{p} \\\\
                    &\approx \pounds 2580.00
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 2580.00$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sam has $\pounds 3.85$ to spend. He buys a pencil for $38 \ \text{p}$ and a ruler for $59 \ \text{p}$. How much does he have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sam has $\pounds 3.85$ to spend. He buys a pencil for $38 \ \text{p}$ and a ruler for $59 \ \text{p}$. How much does he have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

                    &= \pounds 2.88
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On holiday last year Phil bought $10$ post cards at $45 \ \text{p}$ each and $10\ \text{second}$ class stamps at $27 \ \text{p}$ each. How much change did he get from a $\pounds 10$ note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On holiday last year Phil bought $10$ post cards at $45 \ \text{p}$ each and $10\ \text{second}$ class stamps at $27 \ \text{p}$ each. How much change did he get from a $\pounds 10$ note?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}         &= 10 \times 45 + 10 \times 27 \\\\
                            &= 450 + 270 \\\\
                            &= 720 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 7.20 \\\\
\text {Change received}     &= 10 - 7.20 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 2.80
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 2.80$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A family with two adults and four children go to the circus. If an adult ticket costs $\pounds 11.50$ and a child ticket costs $\pounds 3.70$, how much change will they get if they pay with two $\pounds 20$ notes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A family with two adults and four children go to the circus. If an adult ticket costs $\pounds 11.50$ and a child ticket costs $\pounds 3.70$, how much change will they get if they pay with two $\pounds 20$ notes?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total cost}      &= 2 \times  11.50 + 4 \times 3.70 \\\\
                        &= 23 + 14.80 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 37.80 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 2 \times 20 - 37.80 \\\\
                        &= 40 - 37.80 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 2.20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $20\%$ of $30\%$ of $40\%$ of $\pounds 50?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $20\%$ of $30\%$ of $40\%$ of $\pounds 50?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 20 \% \ \text {of} \ 30 \% \ \text {of} \ 40 \% \ \text {of} \ \pounds 50 \\\\
&= \dfrac {20} {100} \times \dfrac {30} {100} \times \dfrac {40} {100} \times 50 \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 30 \times 40 \times 50} {100 \times 100 \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \cancel{0} \times 3 \cancel{0} \times 4 \cancel{0} \times 5 \cancel{0}} {1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0} \times 1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0} \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 4 \times 5} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {120} {100} \\\\
&= \pounds 1.20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 1.20$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A family with two adults and three children go to the Zoo. If an adult ticket costs $\pounds 9.50$ and a child ticket costs $\pounds 2.60$, how much change will they get if they pay with a $\pounds 50$ note? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total cost}      &= 2 \times 9.50 + 3 \times 2.60 \\\\
                        &= 19 + 7.80 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 26.80 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 50 - 26.80 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 23.20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Karen and Fran have some money. Karen has $\pounds 9$ more than Fran, together they have $\pounds 45$. How much money does Karen have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Karen and Fran have some money. Karen has $\pounds 9$ more than Fran, together they have $\pounds 45$. How much money does Karen have?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let Fran has (in $\pounds$) $= a$

Karen has (in $\pounds$) $= a + 9$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + a + 9           &= 45 \\\\
2a + 9              &= 45 \\\\
2a                  &= 45 - 9 \\\\
2a                  &= 36 \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {36} {2} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {2 \times 18} {2} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 18} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a                   &= 18 \\\\
\text{Karen has}    &= a + 9 \\\\
                    &= 18 + 9 \\\\
                    &= \pounds 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 27$

</div>
</div>
