<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $\dfrac{1}{4} \text{ of } 20\% \text{ of } \dfrac{1}{6} \text{ of } 40\% \text{ of } \pounds 1200?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $\dfrac{1}{4} \text{ of } 20\% \text{ of } \dfrac{1}{6} \text{ of } 40\% \text{ of } \pounds 1200?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text{of} \ 20\% \ \text{of} \ \dfrac {1} {6} \ \text{of} \ 40\% \ \text{of} \ \pounds 1200 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times \dfrac {20} {100} \times \dfrac {1} {6} \times \dfrac {40} {100} \times 1200 \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 40 \times 1200} {4 \times 100 \times 6 \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 4 \times 10 \times 2 \times 6 \times 100} {4 \times 100 \times 6 \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \cancel {0} \times \cancel {4} \times 1 \cancel {0} \times 2 \times \cancel {6} \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel {4} \times 1 \cancel {0} \cancel {0} \times \cancel {6} \times \cancel {100}} \\\\
&= 2 \times 2 \\\\
&= \pounds 4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 4$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text{of} \ 20\% \ \text{of} \ \dfrac {1} {6} \ \text{of} \ 40\% \ \text{of} \ \pounds 1200 \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times \dfrac {20} {100} \times \dfrac {1} {6} \times \dfrac {40} {100} \times 1200 \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 40 \times 1200} {4 \times 100 \times 6 \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 4 \times 10 \times 2 \times 6 \times 100} {4 \times 100 \times 6 \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \cancel {0} \times \cancel {4} \times 1 \cancel {0} \times 2 \times \cancel {6} \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel {4} \times 1 \cancel {0} \cancel {0} \times \cancel {6} \times \cancel {100}} \\\\
&= 2 \times 2 \\\\
&= \pounds 4
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If an adult ticket on the bus costs $\pounds 1.50$ and a child ticket costs $90 \ \text{p}$, how much change will a family of $2$ adults and their $3$ children get if they pay with a $\pounds 10$ note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 2 \times \pounds 1.50 + 3 \times 90 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 3 + 3 \times \pounds 0.90 \\\\
                        &= 3 + 2.70 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 5.70 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 10 - 5.70 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.30
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                        &= \dfrac {25} {3} \\\\
                        &= 8 \ \text {remainder} \ 3 \\\\
                        &\approx 8
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Six people pay $\pounds 5.50$ each for a meal in a restaurant. They leave a $10 \%$ tip for the waiter. How much change do they receive from a $\pounds 50$ note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Six people pay $\pounds 5.50$ each for a meal in a restaurant. They leave a $10 \%$ tip for the waiter. How much change do they receive from a $\pounds 50$ note?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of meal}    &= 6 \times 5.50 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 33 \\\\
\text{Tip}              &= 10 \% \text{ of } 33 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{10 \times 33 }{100} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 3.30 \\\\
\text{Total expenses}   &= 33 + 3.30 \\\\
                        &= 36.30 \\\\
\text{Change received}  &= 50 - 36.30 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 13.70
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 13.70$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Eliot made three purchases for $\pounds 3.12, \pounds 10.25$ and $\pounds 4.80$. 

What did he spend in total, to the nearest pound?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

                     &= 18.17 \\\\
                     & \approx \pounds 18
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If I buy $6$ pens at $\pounds 1.15$ each and $10$ refills at $56 \ \text{p}$ each, how much change will I get if I pay with a $\pounds 20$ note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If I buy $6$ pens at $\pounds 1.15$ each and $10$ refills at $56 \ \text{p}$ each, how much change will I get if I pay with a $\pounds 20$ note?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 6 \times \pounds 1.15 + 10 \times 56 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 6 \times \pounds 1.15 + 10 \times \pounds 0.56 \\\\
                        &= 6.90 + 5.60 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 12.50 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 20 - 12.50 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 7.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 7.50$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If you buy $8$ second class stamps costing $44 \ \text{p}$ each, how much change would you receive from $\pounds 5?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If you buy $8$ second class stamps costing $44 \ \text{p}$ each, how much change would you receive from $\pounds 5?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Change received}     &= \pounds 5 - 8 \times 44 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 5 - 8 \times \pounds 0.44 \\\\
                            &= 5 - 3.52 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 1.48
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.48$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ian buys

- $3$ bananas at $12 \ \text{p}$ per banana
- $5$ apples at $11 \ \text{p}$ per apple

If Ian pays with a $\pounds 2$ coin how much change would Ian get? Give your answer in pounds and pence. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ian buys
<emptyline>
- $3$ bananas at $12 \ \text{p}$ per banana
- $5$ apples at $11 \ \text{p}$ per apple
<emptyline>
If Ian pays with a $\pounds 2$ coin how much change would Ian get? Give your answer in pounds and pence. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}         &= 3 \times 12  + 5 \times 11 \\\\
                            &= 36 + 55 \\\\
                            &= 91 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 0.91 \\\\
\text {Change received}     &= 2 - 0.91 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 1.09
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 1.09$

</div>

**Question**

There are twenty four $\pounds 1$ coins, seven $\pounds 2$ coins, six $\pounds 5$ notes, fourteen $\pounds 10$ notes, three $\pounds 20$ notes and one $\pounds 50$ note.

How much money is there in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are twenty four $\pounds 1$ coins, seven $\pounds 2$ coins, six $\pounds 5$ notes, fourteen $\pounds 10$ notes, three $\pounds 20$ notes and one $\pounds 50$ note.
<emptyline>
How much money is there in total?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total money}    &= 24 \times 1 + 7 \times 2 + 6 \times 5 + 14 \times 10 + 3 \times 20 + 50 \\\\
                       &= 24 + 14 + 30 + 140 + 60 + 50 \\\\
                       &= \pounds 318
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 318$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

I exchange all of the money for as many $\pounds 20$ notes as possible.

How many $\pounds 20$ notes do I have now?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Count of } \pounds 20 \text{ notes}    &= \dfrac {318} {20} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 159} {2 \times 10} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 159} {\cancel {2} \times 10} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {159} {10} \\\\
                                                &= 15 \text{ remainder } 9 \\\\
                                                & \approx 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The museum took a total of $\pounds 600$ in entrance fees one Friday. How many people paid to visit the museum that Friday? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The museum took a total of $\pounds 600$ in entrance fees one Friday. How many people paid to visit the museum that Friday? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total people}    &= \dfrac {600} {1.20} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {600 \times 10} {1.20 \times 10} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {600 \times 10} {12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 12 \times 10 \times 10} {12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel {12} \times 10 \times 10} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
                        &= 500
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$500$

</div>
</div>

                        &= \dfrac {600 \times 10} {12} \\\\

cinema for $\pounds 20 \text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the maximum number of people that can go to the

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Since we have to maximise the number of people, let's calculate for only children.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Maximum number of people}    &= \dfrac {20} {3.40} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {20 \times 10} {3.40 \times 10} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {20 \times 10} {34} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {10 \times 2 \times 10} {2 \times 17} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel {2} \times 10} {\cancel {2} \times 17} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {100} {17} \\\\
                                    &= 5 \ \text {remainder} \ 15 \\\\
                                    &\approx 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Since we have to maximise the number of people, let's calculate for only children.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Maximum number of people}    &= \dfrac {20} {3.40} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {20 \times 10} {3.40 \times 10} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {20 \times 10} {34} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {10 \times 2 \times 10} {2 \times 17} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel {2} \times 10} {\cancel {2} \times 17} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {100} {17} \\\\
                                    &= 5 \ \text {remainder} \ 15 \\\\
                                    &\approx 5
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

**Question**

The zoo has a Family Ticket for sale which allows two adults and three children to visit the zoo. The ticket costs $\pounds 38.00$. How much is saved by buying the Family Ticket instead of five separate tickets?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The zoo has a Family Ticket for sale which allows two adults and three children to visit the zoo. The ticket costs $\pounds 38.00$. How much is saved by buying the Family Ticket instead of five separate tickets?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of } 5 \text{ separate tickets}     &= 2 \times 12.50 + 3 \times 8 \\\\
                                                &= 25 + 24 \\\\
                                                &= \pounds 49 \\\\
\text {Money saved}                             &= 49 - 38 \\\\
                                                &= \pounds 11
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Hannah went to the shop. She bought a magazine that cost $\pounds 3.50$, $3$ bars of chocolate that cost $55 \ \text{p}$ each and a packet of sweets. She paid with a $\pounds 10$ note and was given $\pounds 4.20$ change. How much did the sweets cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Hannah went to the shop. She bought a magazine that cost $\pounds 3.50$, $3$ bars of chocolate that cost $55 \ \text{p}$ each and a packet of sweets. She paid with a $\pounds 10$ note and was given $\pounds 4.20$ change. How much did the sweets cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of sweets}                  &= \pounds 10 - \pounds 3.50 - 3 \times 55 \ \text{p} - \pounds 4.20 \\\\
                                        &= \pounds 10 - \pounds 3.50 - 3 \times \pounds 0.55 - \pounds 4.20 \\\\
                                        &= 10 - 3.50 - 1.65 - 4.20 \\\\
                                        &= \pounds 0.65 \\\\
                                        &= 65 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$65 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

John paid a total of $\pounds 5.15$ for a jar of coffee, a carton of milk and a bag of sugar. 
The jar of coffee cost $\pounds 3.69$ and the carton of milk cost $89 \ \text{p}$. How much did the bag of sugar cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John paid a total of $\pounds 5.15$ for a jar of coffee, a carton of milk and a bag of sugar. 
The jar of coffee cost $\pounds 3.69$ and the carton of milk cost $89 \ \text{p}$. How much did the bag of sugar cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of sugar}       &= \pounds 5.15 - \pounds 3.69 - 89 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= 515 \ \text{p} - 369 \ \text{p} - 89 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= 146 - 89 \\\\
                            &= 57 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $5$ mugs cost $\pounds 3.50$ and $8$ pens cost $\pounds 6.80$ how much change do I get from $\pounds 10$ if I buy $7$ mugs and $5$ pens? 
You MUST show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $5$ mugs cost $\pounds 3.50$ and $8$ pens cost $\pounds 6.80$ how much change do I get from $\pounds 10$ if I buy $7$ mugs and $5$ pens? 
You MUST show your working.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of a mug}   &= \dfrac {3.50} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 0.70} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 0.70} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 0.70 \\\\
\text {Cost of a pen}   &= \dfrac {6.80} {8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {8 \times 0.85} {8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {8} \times 0.85} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 0.85 \\\\
\text {Money spent}     &= 7 \times 0.70 + 5 \times 0.85 \\\\
                        &= 4.90 + 4.25 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 9.15 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 10 - 9.15 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 0.85
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 0.85$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Matthew buys $2$ sandwiches and a cookie with a $\pounds 5$ note.

How much change does he receive?

| Price List |                  |
|:----------:|:---------------:|
|  Sandwich  | $\pounds 1.49 $ |
|   Cookie   | $\pounds 0.69 $ |
|  Ice Lolly | $\pounds 0.49 $ |
|    Soda    | $\pounds 0.99 $ |


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Matthew buys $2$ sandwiches and a cookie with a $\pounds 5$ note.

|  Ice Lolly | $\pounds 0.49 $ |
|    Soda    | $\pounds 0.99 $ |
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>

\begin{aligned}

                        &= 2.98 + 0.69 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 3.67 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 5 - 3.67 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.33
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which is better value, $600 \ \text{g}$ for $\pounds 3$ or $500 \ \text{g}$ for $\pounds 2.75?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which is better value, $600 \ \text{g}$ for $\pounds 3$ or $500 \ \text{g}$ for $\pounds 2.75?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's calculate the cost per gram for both.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {First}           &= \dfrac {\pounds 3} {600} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {300 \ \text{p}} {600} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {300} {300 \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{300}} {\cancel{300} \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                        &= 0.5 \ \text{p per gram} \\\\
\text {Second}          &= \dfrac {\pounds 2.75} {500} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {275 \ \text{p}} {500} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 55} {5 \times 100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 55} {\cancel {5} \times 100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {55} {100} \\\\
                        &= 0.55 \ \text{p per gram}
\end{aligned}
$

Better value $= 600 \ \text {g}$ for $\pounds 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$600 \ \text{g} \ \text{for} \ \pounds 3$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The local bakery sells muffins at $85 \ \text{p}$ each. I have $\pounds 15$ to spend. How many muffins can I buy? 

- $17$
- $16$
- $15$
- $14$
- $20$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

- $20$
</code></pre>

                            &= \dfrac {\pounds 15} {85 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1500 \ \text{p}} {85 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 300} {5 \times 17} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 300} {\cancel {5} \times 17} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {300} {17} \\\\

                            &\approx 17
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Look carefully at the following five supermarket offers:

$A$- Buy one get one free.

$B$- Buy one get the second for half price.

$C$- Buy two get one free.

$D$- Buy four and pay only for three.

$E$- One-third off all prices.

Two pairs of these offers actually give the same value for money. Write down the letters representing both of these pairs in the spaces below:

$\ldots$ and $\ldots$ give the same value for money, and

$\ldots$ and $\ldots$ give the same value for money.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Look carefully at the following five supermarket offers:
<emptyline>
$A$- Buy one get one free.
<emptyline>
$B$- Buy one get the second for half price.
<emptyline>
$C$- Buy two get one free.
<emptyline>
$D$- Buy four and pay only for three.
<emptyline>
$E$- One-third off all prices.
<emptyline>
Two pairs of these offers actually give the same value for money. Write down the letters representing both of these pairs in the spaces below:
<emptyline>
$\ldots$ and $\ldots$ give the same value for money, and
<emptyline>
$\ldots$ and $\ldots$ give the same value for money.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's take the original price $=a$

Now let's find the number of items one gets in each of the offer and the money one has to pay for it.

**Offer A : Buy one get one free.** 

Items $=2$ 

  Price $=a$

$
\begin{aligned} 
    \text{Item}                   & : \text{Price}   \\\\
    2                             & : a             \\\\
    \dfrac {2}{2}                 & : \dfrac {a}{2} \\\\
    \dfrac {\cancel 2}{\cancel 2} & : \dfrac {a}{2} \\\\
    1                             & : \dfrac {a}{2} 
\end{aligned}
$

**Offer B : Buy one get the second for half price.** 

Items $=2$ 

  Price $=a + \dfrac{a}{2}$

$
\begin{aligned} 
    \text{Item}                   & : \text{Price}                                    \\\\
    2                             & : a + \dfrac {a}{2}                               \\\\
    2                             & : \dfrac {a}{1} + \dfrac {a}{2}                   \\\\
    2                             & : \dfrac {a \times 2}{1 \times 2} + \dfrac {a}{2} \\\\
    2 \times \dfrac{1}{2}         & : \dfrac {2a  + a} {2} \times  \dfrac{1}{2}       \\\\
    \dfrac {\cancel 2}{\cancel 2} & : \dfrac {3a} {4}                                 \\\\
    1                             & : \dfrac {3a}{4}                                  
\end{aligned}
$

**Offer C : Buy two get one free.** 

Items $=3$ 

  Price $=2a$

$
\begin{aligned} 
    \text{Item}                   & : \text{Price}       \\\\
    3                             & : 2a                \\\\
    \dfrac {3}{3}                 & : \dfrac {2a}{3}    \\\\
    \dfrac {\cancel 3}{\cancel 3} & : \dfrac {2a}{3}    \\\\
    1                             & : \dfrac {2a}{3} 
\end{aligned}
$

**Offer D : Buy four and pay only for three.** 

Items $=4$ 

  Price $=3a$

$
\begin{aligned} 
    \text{Item}                   & : \text{Price}     \\\\
    4                             & : 3a              \\\\
    \dfrac {4}{4}                 & : \dfrac {3a} {4} \\\\    
    \dfrac {\cancel 4}{\cancel 4} & : \dfrac {3a} {4} \\\\
    1                             & : \dfrac {3a}{4}  
\end{aligned}
$

**Offer E : One-third off all prices** 

Items $=1$ 

  Pay $=a - \dfrac {1}{3}$

$
\begin{aligned} 
    \text{Item} & : \text{Price}                                    \\\\
    1           & : a - \dfrac {1}{3}                               \\\\
    1           & : \dfrac {a}{1} - \dfrac {1}{3}                   \\\\
    1           & : \dfrac {a \times 3}{1 \times 3} - \dfrac {1}{3} \\\\
    1           & : \dfrac {3a} {3} -  \dfrac{1}{3}                 \\\\
    1           & : \dfrac {3a - 1} {3}                             \\\\
    1           & : \dfrac {2a}{3}                                  
\end{aligned}
$

Ratio of one item cost under the offers:

$
\begin{aligned} 
\text {Offer A} &= \dfrac {a}{2} \\\\
\text {Offer B} &= \dfrac {3a}{4} \\\\
\text {Offer C} &= \dfrac {2a}{3}  \\\\
\text {Offer D} &= \dfrac {3a}{4} \\\\
\text {Offer E} &= \dfrac {2a}{3}
\end{aligned}
$

As we can see above,

$B = D$ and $C = E$

$\underline {\text {B}}$ and  $\underline {\text {D}}$ give the same value for money, and

$\underline {\text {C}}$ and  $\underline {\text {E}}$ give the same value for money.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\underline {\text {B}}$ and  $\underline {\text {D}}$ give the same value for money, and

$\underline {\text {C}}$ and  $\underline {\text {E}}$ give the same value for money.

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I have $\pounds 8.17$ credit on my mobile phone. At the end of a phone call this falls 
to $\pounds 7.65$. 
How much did the call cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

to $\pounds 7.65$. 
How much did the call cost?
</code></pre>

                            &= \pounds 0.52

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Fiona buys:

* $3$ cans of coke $@ \ 85 \ \text{p}$ per can
* $5$ samosas $@ \ 30 \ \text{p}$ per samosa

If Fiona pays with a $\pounds 5$ note, how much change does she get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Fiona buys:
<emptyline>
* $3$ cans of coke $@ \ 85 \ \text{p}$ per can
* $5$ samosas $@ \ 30 \ \text{p}$ per samosa
<emptyline>
If Fiona pays with a $\pounds 5$ note, how much change does she get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 3 \times 85 + 5 \times 30 \\\\
                        &= 255 + 150 \\\\
                        &= 405 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.05 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 5 - 4.05 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 0.95
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 0.95$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Once upon a time, in the Ancient Wizarding World of Haberdasher's:

One pound $= 20 \ \text{shillings}$ 

One shilling $= 12 \ \text{pence}$

A large Margarine-beer costs $1 \ \text{pound} \ 4 \ \text{shillings}$ and $9 \ \text{pence}$.

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Football cards are sold in packs. 

Each pack contains $8$ cards.

How many packs of football cards did Ryan buy altogether?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Football cards are sold in packs. 
<emptyline>
Each pack contains $8$ cards.
<emptyline>
How many packs of football cards did Ryan buy altogether?
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of packs}            &= \dfrac {\text {Total cards}} {\text {Cards in a pack}} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {128} {8} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {16 \times 8} {8} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {16 \times \cancel{8}} {\cancel{8}} \\\\
                                   &= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$16$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Suki buys $500 \ \text{g}$ of sugar at $\pounds 1.10$ per kilogram and $750 \ \text{g}$ of plain flour at $\pounds 1.12$ per kilogram. 
How much change did she receive from a $\pounds 5$ note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Suki buys $500 \ \text{g}$ of sugar at $\pounds 1.10$ per kilogram and $750 \ \text{g}$ of plain flour at $\pounds 1.12$ per kilogram. 
How much change did she receive from a $\pounds 5$ note?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of} \ 500 \ \text {g sugar}     &= \dfrac {500} {1000} \ \text{kg} \times 1.10 \\\\
                                            &= 0.5 \times 1.10 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 0.55 \\\\
\text {Cost of} \ 750 \ \text {g flour}     &= \dfrac {750} {1000} \ \text{kg} \times 1.12 \\\\
                                            &= 0.75 \times 1.12 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 0.84 \\\\
\text {Total cost}                          &= 0.55 + 0.84 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 1.39 \\\\
\text {Change received}                     &= 5 - 1.39 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 3.61
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 3.61$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Charlotte buys $500 \ \text{g}$ of cheese which costs $\pounds 5.30$ per kilogram, six bananas at $15 \ \text{p}$ each and two chocolate bars at $56 \ \text{p}$ each. How much change will she have from a ten pound note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Charlotte buys $500 \ \text{g}$ of cheese which costs $\pounds 5.30$ per kilogram, six bananas at $15 \ \text{p}$ each and two chocolate bars at $56 \ \text{p}$ each. How much change will she have from a ten pound note?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cheese}           &= \dfrac {500} {1000} \ \text{kg} \times 5.30 \\\\
                        &= 0.5 \times 5.30 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 2.65 \\\\
\text{Bananas}          &= 6 \times 15 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 6 \times \pounds \dfrac {15} {100} \\\\
                        &= 6 \times 0.15 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 0.9 \\\\
\text{Chocolate bars}   &= 2 \times 56 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 2 \times \pounds \dfrac {56} {100} \\\\
                        &= 2 \times 0.56 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.12 \\\\
\text {Total cost}      &= 2.65 + 0.9 + 1.12 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.67 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 10 - 4.67 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 5.33
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 5.33$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**


Maria telephoned Priya on her mobile. The rate for the first three minutes was $7 \ \text{p}$ per minute. After that the telephone call cost $5 \ \text{p}$ per minute. The telephone call lasted $21 \ \text{minutes}$. How much did it cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">
Maria telephoned Priya on her mobile. The rate for the first three minutes was $7 \ \text{p}$ per minute. After that the telephone call cost $5 \ \text{p}$ per minute. The telephone call lasted $21 \ \text{minutes}$. How much did it cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost}   &= 7 \times 3 + 5 \times (21 -3) \\\\
                    &= 21 + 5 \times 18 \\\\
                    &= 21 + 90 \\\\
                    &= 111 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$111 \ \text{p}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$32$ students and $4$ members of staff from Encrypt School are going to a lecture on code-breaking.

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2009/group-1/s01-q15-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2009/group-1/s01-q15-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2009/group-1/s01-q15-i00.png")

Code-Breaking Lecture

Ticket Prices

Students: $\pounds 14.00$ each
Adults: $\pounds 15.00$ each

$1$ free adult ticket provided with every $10$ student tickets purchased

How much will the tickets cost in total for the school party?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$32$ students and $4$ members of staff from Encrypt School are going to a lecture on code-breaking.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
Code-Breaking Lecture
<emptyline>
Ticket Prices
<emptyline>
Students: $\pounds 14.00$ each
Adults: $\pounds 15.00$ each
<emptyline>
$1$ free adult ticket provided with every $10$ student tickets purchased
<emptyline>
How much will the tickets cost in total for the school party?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Free adult tickets}  &= \dfrac{32}{10} \\\\
                            &= 3 \ \text{remainder} \ 2 \\\\
                            &\approx 3
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total cost}  &= \text{Students cost} + \text{Adults cost} \\\\
                    &= 32 \times 14 + (4 - 3) \times 15 \\\\
                    &= 32 \times 14 + 1 \times 15 \\\\
                    &= 448 + 15 \\\\
                    &= \pounds 463
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 463$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the greatest number of $\pounds 5$ notes she could receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the greatest number of $\pounds 5$ notes she could receive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total amount}   
                                                &= 12 \times 50 \ \text{p} + 18 \times 20 \ \text{p} + 7 \times 10 \ \text{p} + 12 \times 2 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                                &= 600 + 360 + 70 + 24 \\\\
                                                &= 1054 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Number of} \ \pounds 5 \ \text {notes}   &= \dfrac {1054 \ \text{p}} {\pounds 5} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {1054 \ \text{p}} {500 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                                &= 2 \ \text {remainder} \ 54 \\\\
                                                &\approx 2
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Joanna gets $\pounds 5.00$ pocket money each week and 
her younger sister, Amy, gets $\pounds 3.50$ each week. 
After $5 \ \text{weeks}$, Joanna saved all her money, but Amy 
spent $75 \ \text{p}$ a week on stickers. 

How much more does Joanna now have compared to Amy? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Joanna gets $\pounds 5.00$ pocket money each week and 
her younger sister, Amy, gets $\pounds 3.50$ each week. 
After $5 \ \text{weeks}$, Joanna saved all her money, but Amy 
spent $75 \ \text{p}$ a week on stickers. 
<emptyline>
How much more does Joanna now have compared to Amy? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Difference}  &= 5 \times \pounds 5 - (5 \times \pounds 3.50 - 5 \times 75 \ \text{p}) \\\\
                    &= \pounds 25 - (\pounds 17.50 - 5 \times \pounds 0.75) \\\\
                    &= 25 - (17.50 - 3.75) \\\\
                    &= 25 - 13.75 \\\\
                    &= \pounds 11.25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 11.25$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Rose buys a book which costs $\pounds 7.46$.

She pays for the book with a $\pounds 10$ note and receives $4$ coins as her change.

Which $4$ coins does Rose receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Rose buys a book which costs $\pounds 7.46$.
<emptyline>
She pays for the book with a $\pounds 10$ note and receives $4$ coins as her change.
<emptyline>
Which $4$ coins does Rose receive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- The coins available are: $1 \ \text{p}$, $2 \ \text{p}$, $5 \ \text{p}$, $10 \ \text{p}$, $20 \ \text{p}$, $50 \ \text{p}$, $\pounds 1$, $\pounds 2$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Paula was given $\pounds 40$ for her birthday.
<emptyline>
She used some of this money to buy a scarf for $\pounds 14.95$ and a hat for $\pounds 8.45$
<emptyline>
How much of her birthday money does she have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money  spent}  &= 14.95 + 8.45 \\\\
                    &= \pounds 23.40 \\\\
\text{Money  left}  &= \text{Money given} - \text{Money spent} \\\\
                    &= 40 - 23.40 \\\\
                    &= \pounds 16.60
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 16.60$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $15\%$ of $\pounds 3$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $15\%$ of $\pounds 3$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 15 \% \times \pounds 3 \\\\
&= \dfrac {15} {100} \times 300 \ \text{p} \\\\
&= \dfrac {15 \times 300} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {15 \times 3 \cancel {00}} {1 \cancel {00}} \\\\
&= 15 \times 3 \\\\
&= 45 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$45 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The cost of the gas is $7 \ \text{p}$ for each unit. Also there is a fixed charge of $\pounds 12.50$ to be paid. Work out the total cost of the gas and the fixed charge.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The cost of the gas is $7 \ \text{p}$ for each unit. Also there is a fixed charge of $\pounds 12.50$ to be paid. Work out the total cost of the gas and the fixed charge.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total cost}      &= 780 \times 7 \ \text{p} + \pounds 12.50 \\\\
                        &= 780 \times \pounds 0.07 + \pounds 12.50 \\\\
                        &= 54.60 + 12.50 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 67.10
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 67.10$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Finally, $10 \%$ of this total is then added on for tax purposes.  Work out the final cost.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Finally, $10 \%$ of this total is then added on for tax purposes.  Work out the final cost.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If $10 \%$ is added for tax, then the total cost will be $100 + 10 = 110 \%$ of the original cost. 

Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Final cost}  &= 110 \% \times 67.10 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {110} {100} \times 67.10 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {110 \times 67.10} {100} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {7381} {100} \\\\
                    &= \pounds 73.81
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Tax}          &= 10 \% \text{ of } \pounds 67.10 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 67.10 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {10 \times 67.10} {100} \\\\
                    &= \pounds 6.71 \\\\
\text{Final cost}   &= 67.10 + 6.71 \\\\
                    &= \pounds 73.81
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 73.81$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Work out $35 \%$ of $\pounds 4$.

At present, the company calculates that the cost of the jam is $20 \ \text{p}$ for every $100 \ \text{g}$.

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

For a small jar, containing $200 \ \text{g}$ of jam, the lid costs $10 \ \text{p}$ and the jar $50 \ \text{p}$. What is the total cost of the jar of jam?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">For a small jar, containing $200 \ \text{g}$ of jam, the lid costs $10 \ \text{p}$ and the jar $50 \ \text{p}$. What is the total cost of the jar of jam?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 100 \text{g} jam}     &= 20 \\\\
\text{Cost of 1 \text{g} jam}       &= \dfrac{20}{100} \\\\
                                    &= 0.20 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Cost of 200 \text{g} jam}     &= 200 \times \dfrac{20}{100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac{200 \times 20}{100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac{2 \cancel{00} \times 20}{1\cancel{00}} \\\\
                                    &= 2 \times 20 \\\\
                                    &= 40 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Total cost}                   &= 50 + 10  + 40  \\\\
                                    &= 100 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 1.00
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.00$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A medium jar contains $350 \ \text{g}$ of jam and the medium jar costs $60 \ \text{p}$. If the total cost is $\pounds 1.55$, what is the cost of the lid for the medium jar of jam?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A medium jar contains $350 \ \text{g}$ of jam and the medium jar costs $60 \ \text{p}$. If the total cost is $\pounds 1.55$, what is the cost of the lid for the medium jar of jam?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using the cost of jam per gram calculated in the previous question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of the lid} &= \pounds 1.55 - 350 \times 0.20 \ \text{p} - 60 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 155 \ \text{p} - 70 \ \text{p} - 60 \ \text{p} \\\\
                        &= 155 - 70 - 60 \\\\
                        &= 155 - 130 \\\\
                        &= 25 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25 \ \text{p}$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A large jar of jam contains $500 \ \text{g}$ of jam and the total cost is $\pounds 3.00$. If the jar costs four times as much as the lid, what does the jar cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A large jar of jam contains $500 \ \text{g}$ of jam and the total cost is $\pounds 3.00$. If the jar costs four times as much as the lid, what does the jar cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of lid $= a$

Cost of the jar $= 4a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4a + a + 500 \times 0.20 \ \text{p}     &= \pounds 3 \\\\
5a + 100 \ \text{p}                    &= 300 \ \text{p} \\\\
5a                                      &= 300 - 100 \\\\
5a                                      &= 200 \\\\
a                                       &= \dfrac {200} {5} \\\\
a                                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 40} {5} \\\\
a                                       &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 40} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
a                                       &= 40 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Cost of jar}                     &= 4a \\\\
                                        &= 4 \times 40 \\\\
                                        &= 160 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                        &= \pounds 1.60
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.60$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

A catering jar with a lid costing $65  \ \text{p}$ and a jar costing $\pounds 2$ has a total cost of $\pounds 4.65$. What weight of jam does the catering jar contain?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A catering jar with a lid costing $65  \ \text{p}$ and a jar costing $\pounds 2$ has a total cost of $\pounds 4.65$. What weight of jam does the catering jar contain?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of jam $= w$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 2 + 65 \ \text{p} + 0.20 \times w           &= \pounds 4.65 \\\\
200 \ \text{p} + 65 \ \text{p} + 0.20 \times w      &= 465 \ \text{p} \\\\
0.2w + 265                                          &= 465 \\\\
0.2w                                                &= 465 - 265 \\\\
0.2w                                                &= 200 \\\\
w                                                   &= \dfrac {200} {0.2} \\\\
w                                                   &= \dfrac {200 \times 10} {0.2 \times 10} \\\\
w                                                   &= \dfrac {2000} {2} \\\\
w                                                   &= \dfrac {2 \times 1000} {2} \\\\
w                                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 1000} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
w                                                   &= 1000 \ \text{g} \\\\
w                                                   &= 1 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight of jam $= 1 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $15 \%$ of $\pounds 5$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $15 \%$ of $\pounds 5$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 15 \% \ \text {of} \ \pounds 5 \\\\
&= \dfrac {15} {100} \times 500 \ \text{p} \\\\
&= \dfrac {15 \times 500} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {15 \times 5 \cancel{00}} {1 \cancel{00}} \\\\
&= 15 \times 5 \\\\
&= 75 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $30 \%$ of $\pounds 16.80$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $30 \%$ of $\pounds 16.80$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

&=\dfrac {504} {100} \\\\
&= \pounds 5.04
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

My garden centre sells Summer bedding plants at $85 \ \text{p}$ each. I have $\pounds 30$ to spend. How many plants can I buy? Show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">My garden centre sells Summer bedding plants at $85 \ \text{p}$ each. I have $\pounds 30$ to spend. How many plants can I buy? Show your working.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of plants}     &= \dfrac {\text{Total money}} {\text{Cost of a plant}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\pounds 30} {85 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {3000 \ \text{p}} {85 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 600} {5 \times 17} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 600} {\cancel {5} \times 17} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {600} {17} \\\\
                            &= 35 \ \text {remainder} \ 5 \\\\
                            &\approx 35
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$35$

</div>
</div>

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of plants}     &= \dfrac {\text{Total money}} {\text{Cost of a plant}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\pounds 30} {85 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {3000 \ \text{p}} {85 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 600} {5 \times 17} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 600} {\cancel {5} \times 17} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {600} {17} \\\\
                            &= 35 \ \text {remainder} \ 5 \\\\
                            &\approx 35
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Cans of coke cost $\pounds 1.16$ each. I buy $4$ cans and pay with a $\pounds 10$ note. How much change do I receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Cans of coke cost $\pounds 1.16$ each. I buy $4$ cans and pay with a $\pounds 10$ note. How much change do I receive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 4 \times 1.16 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.64 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 10 - 4.64 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 5.36
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 5.36$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alison went to the supermarket. 

![papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-i00.png "papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-i00.png")

She bought two cans of cola costing $53 \ \text{p}$ each, three packets of crisps costing $27 \ \text{p}$ each and a large bar of chocolate that costs $\pounds 1.24$.

How much change did she get from $\pounds 5?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alison went to the supermarket. 
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
She bought two cans of cola costing $53 \ \text{p}$ each, three packets of crisps costing $27 \ \text{p}$ each and a large bar of chocolate that costs $\pounds 1.24$.
<emptyline>
How much change did she get from $\pounds 5?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
