</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 2 \times 53 \ \text{p} + 3 \times 27 \ \text{p} + \pounds 1.24 \\\\
                        &= 2 \times \pounds 0.53 + 3 \times \pounds 0.27 + \pounds 1.24 \\\\
                        &= 1.06 + 0.81 + 1.24 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 3.11 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 5 - 3.11 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.89
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Malcolm buys $7$ packets of biscuits at $73 \ \text{p}$ each and $9$ large cakes at $\pounds 1.13$ each. How much change will he receive from a $\pounds 20$ note?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Malcolm buys $7$ packets of biscuits at $73 \ \text{p}$ each and $9$ large cakes at $\pounds 1.13$ each. How much change will he receive from a $\pounds 20$ note?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

_no_dot
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}     &= 7 \times 73 \ \text{p} + 9 \times \pounds 1.13 \\\\
                        &= 7 \times \pounds 0.73 + \pounds 10.17 \\\\
                        &= 5.11 + 10.17 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 15.28 \\\\
\text {Change received} &= 20 - 15.28 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 4.72
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What percentage is $15 \ \text{p}$ out of $\pounds 3.00?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What percentage is $15 \ \text{p}$ out of $\pounds 3.00?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Percentage}  &= \dfrac{15 \ \text{p}}{\pounds 3.00} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{15 \ \text{p}}{300 \ \text{p}} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {15} {300} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {15 \times 100} {300} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3 \times 5 \times 100} {3 \times 100} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 5 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel {3} \times \cancel {100}} \\\\
                    &= 5 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5 \%$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jack buys **four** apples.

He pays with a $\pounds 2$ coin.

He gets $\pounds 1.20$ change.

How much does **one** apple cost?

![papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q01-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q01-s01-i00.png "papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q01-s01-i00.png")


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jack buys **four** apples.
<emptyline>
He pays with a $\pounds 2$ coin.
<emptyline>
He gets $\pounds 1.20$ change.
<emptyline>
How much does **one** apple cost?
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of an apple}    &= \dfrac {2 - 1.20} {4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {0.80} {4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {0.20 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {0.20 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 0.20 \\\\
                            &= 20 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

                            &= \dfrac {0.20 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Oranges cost $15 \ \text{p}$ each. 

Raj has a $\pounds 1$ coin.

What is the greatest number of oranges Raj can buy with $\pounds 1$?

![papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q01-s02-i00.png](/assets/papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q01-s02-i00.png "papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q01-s02-i00.png")


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Oranges cost $15 \ \text{p}$ each. 
<emptyline>
Raj has a $\pounds 1$ coin.
<emptyline>
What is the greatest number of oranges Raj can buy with $\pounds 1$?
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Count}   &= \dfrac {\text{Total money}} {\text {Cost of an orange}} \\\\
                &= \dfrac {\pounds 1} {15 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                &= \dfrac {100 \ \text{p}} {15 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                &= 6 \ \text {remainder} \ 10 \\\\
                &\approx 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6 \ \text {oranges}$

</div>
</div>
